jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Creative Production & Fabrication
jobs.description:
**Location:** Torrance, CA  
**Schedule:** Full\-time, Monday–Friday, in person

SCPS Unlimited is a creative fabrication company specializing in custom builds, experiential projects, prototypes, scenic fabrication, and unique one\-off projects.

We are looking for an organized, proactive **Project Coordinator** to support our Project Management team and help keep projects organized, on schedule, and moving forward.

This role is a good fit for someone who takes initiative, communicates well, manages competing priorities, and enjoys working in a fast\-paced creative environment.

Responsibilities

● Keep PMs and projects organized by maintaining task lists, deadlines, follow\-ups, schedules, meeting notes, and action items

● Prioritize competing needs, anticipate upcoming project requirements, and proactively communicate updates, delays, and items requiring attention

● Assist with gathering data for project quotes, schedules, design/fabrication calendars, SOWs, client materials, and project documentation

● Source materials, components, vendors, subcontractors, equipment, and other project needs

● Track purchasing, BOMs, project expenses, and returns

● Coordinate shipping, deliveries, travel, lodging, rentals, and installation logistics

● Participate in project and production meetings, capture action items, and follow through on assigned responsibilities

● Assist with client communication and coordination, along with occasional marketing, recruiting, and administrative support

**What We're Looking For**

● Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail

● Proactive communication and reliable follow\-through

● Ability to prioritize and work with an appropriate sense of urgency

● Initiative, ownership, and strong problem\-solving skills

● Strong written and verbal communication

● Comfortable working across multiple projects with changing priorities

● Experience in project coordination, production, experiential, events, fabrication, entertainment, or a related environment preferred

● Google Workspace proficiency required; Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus

**This is a full\-time, in\-person position at our Torrance facility.**

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 – 45\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for Parishes
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for parishes provides leadership for the implementation of the Salesian Design–Serve–Reflect Initiative across the nine Salesian parishes of the USA West Province. This position strengthens parish youth ministry by accompanying parish leaders, mentoring youth, developing adult companions, coordinating service opportunities, and ensuring consistent implementation of the Province's youth ministry framework.

Working closely with parish staff, volunteers, and provincial leadership who support young people (ages 14–30\) to become missionary disciples through leadership, service, theological reflection, and active participation in parish life. The position also develops resources, evaluates outcomes, and helps build a sustainable and replicable model of youth ministry throughout the Province.

Work with Youth Ministry Delegate to assist in the coordination of pastors, associate pastors, and lay members at parishes. Support the coordinator of parishes to:

* Ensure the development, implementation, and evaluation of the Standards and Benchmarks of the Salesian Parish.
* Fostering communication and collaboration amongst the different parishes of the Province (emphasizing best practices).
* Supporting the ongoing formation of Salesians and laity who share responsibility for parish ministry, through meetings and moments of formation.
* Supports the Provincial Commission for Parishes and assists with province\-wide parish coordination.
* Serves as the primary administrative support for parish youth ministry initiatives.
* Assists with additional Province Youth Ministry initiatives as responsibilities expand.

This position is funded through a one\-year grant with the expectation of renewal based on funding availability and program success.

Add additional responsibilities under Youth Ministry as this position expands; they will take on other responsibilities, including formation, vocation, and other projects as they arise under the Youth Ministry Department.

Pay: $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA

jobs.description:
**Athena Coding** is an education company that provides after\-school enrichment programs in coding, STEAM, art, and other subjects for elementary and middle school students.

We are looking for a **Regional Program Coordinator** to support our Southern California programs. This is a **part\-time, hourly position** that combines remote administrative work with local travel to school sites and other locations throughout Southern California.

This is **not a fully remote position**. While much of the administrative work can be completed from home, you must live in the Los Angeles/Southern California area, have reliable transportation, and be comfortable traveling to locations including **Alhambra, Santa Ana, Rialto, and other nearby program sites as needed**.

Schedule

Approximately **20–25 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours as our programs grow.

The schedule will vary from week to week depending on program needs. Most work takes place on weekdays, generally between **10:00 AM and 6:00 PM**.

Some weeks may involve more remote administrative work, while others may include district meetings, school visits, equipment/material deliveries, or other on\-site responsibilities.

Specific working hours will be scheduled based on operational needs. This is not a daily travel position.

Compensation

**$27–$32 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Mileage for approved work\-related travel between school sites, meetings, storage locations, and other assigned locations will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy.**

Responsibilities

* Serve as an operational point person for Athena Coding's Southern California programs
* Communicate with instructors, school\-site staff, and district partners
* Help coordinate instructor schedules, substitutions, and coverage
* Visit school sites to observe programs and address operational needs
* Attend occasional district or school meetings on Athena Coding's behalf
* Assist with onboarding and supporting instructors
* Follow up with instructors regarding training, compliance requirements, and program expectations
* Coordinate distribution and collection of curriculum materials, technology, and other program supplies
* Pick up, organize, or deliver materials from our local storage location as needed
* Help troubleshoot day\-to\-day program issues and communicate important updates to the appropriate team members
* Maintain organized records and track outstanding tasks and follow\-ups
* Assist with preparation for new program launches and transitions

We're Looking for Someone Who

* Is exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple programs and deadlines
* Communicates clearly and professionally by email, phone, and text
* Is dependable and comfortable taking ownership of tasks through completion
* Can work independently without constant supervision
* Is comfortable communicating with teachers, school administrators, instructors, and job applicants
* Is able to adapt when schedules or program needs change
* Has strong judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Is comfortable using Google Workspace and learning web\-based administrative platforms
* Has reliable transportation and is willing to drive throughout the Southern California region as needed
* Is comfortable occasionally transporting program materials or equipment

Experience in **education, after\-school programming, operations, staffing, recruiting, or program coordination** is preferred but not required.

Requirements

* Must reside in Southern California within reasonable driving distance of the greater Los Angeles area
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Ability to travel to school sites and meetings as needed
* Availability during weekday business and after\-school hours
* High school diploma required; college degree or equivalent professional experience preferred

This is a great fit for someone who likes a combination of **independent administrative work and getting out into the field**, and who enjoys solving problems and keeping a geographically distributed program running smoothly.

Athena Coding is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

* Flexible schedule

jobs.description:
Under the guidance and direction of the Director of IPE, the Program Coordinator supports the coordination and implementation of Interprofessional Education (IPE) learning experiences, activities, and related programming.  

  

  

This role collaborates closely with all members of the IPE support team to assist in the development, scheduling, implementation, and monitoring of IPE learning experiences and activities. The Program Coordinator helps ensure smooth delivery of IPE sessions by managing logistics, maintaining communication with stakeholders, and supporting day\-to\-day program operations across campus locations.
  

  

Based in Pomona, California, this position is primarily in\-person during the IPE academic semesters, with work focused on supporting students, faculty, and staff in IPE\-related activities. Outside of the academic semesters, the role continues with responsibilities related to IPE and broader university duties, including preparation for the upcoming academic year.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), video conferencing tools (e.g., Zoom), and learning management systems (e.g., Canvas or similar).
* Ability and willingness to learn new digital platforms and software tools quickly.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively and maintain positive, professional relationships with faculty, staff, students, and other stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to follow through on assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Capable of performing on\-campus duties, including walking between locations and supporting in\-person activities.
* Ability to receive constructive feedback in a positive and professional manner, and to apply it for continuous learning and professional growth.
* Demonstrate a commitment to working for an organization that values and promotes humanism.

Required Qualifications

* High School Diploma or equivalent
  

  

**Experience or Training:**  

  

* Prior experience in an academic, healthcare, or educational setting preferred.
* Experience in customer service, administrative support, or data entry/management is desirable.

Preference will be given to individuals with Bachelor’s degree, preferably in education, healthcare, communication, or a related field.

**Learning Management System (****LMS****) and** **IPE** **Content Support:**

**Key Responsibilities**
**IPE** **Data, Participation, and Assessment Tracking:**  

  

* Supports the collection, tracking, organization, and maintenance of participation, assessment, program, and other data related to IPE activities, including documentation for program evaluation, accreditation, and institutional reporting as assigned.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Meeting and Program Participation:**  

  

* Attends IPE team meetings and supports IPE program and learning experience planning discussions. May take notes, prepare materials, or contribute feedback based on student and facilitator needs.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Administrative and Logistical Support:**  

  

* Assists with room scheduling, supply preparation, and on\-site coordination for IPE activities held on or off campus.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Support to** **CETL** **Units and other duties as assigned:**

jobs.title: Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine at USC has an immediate opening for a bilingual (English\-Spanish) Research Coordinator II to assist in the *All of Us Research Program* funded by the National Institutes of Health. This position will report to the USC Principal Investigator.

***All of Us*** **Research Program Goals and Summary**


The *All of Us* Research Program is funded by the National Institutes of Health and part of the Precision Medicine Initiative. It seeks to build one of the largest, most diverse biomedical data resources of its kind, with information gathered from 1 million \+ participants across America. This program will be one of the most diverse health databases in history. Researchers will use the data to learn how our biology, lifestyle, and environment affect health. This may one day help them find ways to treat and prevent disease. *All of Us* is building a diverse database that can inform thousands of studies on a variety of health conditions.

**Job Responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* Present the *All of Us* Research Program opportunity to eligible patients at Keck Medicine, LA General, and partnering clinics (in person or by phone).
* Interact with clinic staff as needed to create partnerships and increase support of the program.
* Help enroll interested participants by assisting with the consent process and survey completion through the *All of Us* research portal.
* Take physical measurements, vital signs and assist with biospecimen collection activities
* Contact potential participants to complete retention activities
* Use REDCap to document all patient contacts for both recruitment and retention


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelors Degree
* Willing and able to travel to off\-site locations approximately once a week
* Strong organization, attention to detail and verbal communication


Preferred Qualifications

* Bilingual (English and Spanish)


The hourly rate range for this position is $35\.53 \- $38\.34\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Skills: Administrative or research experience. Knowledge of medical environment and terminology. Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations. Proficient with MS Office applications. Demonstrated effective communication and writing skills. Ability to multi\-task. Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team as well as independently. Preferred Experience: 3 years Preferred Skills: Staff education and orientation experience. Knowledge of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

jobs.description:
Overview::
**Ready to advance your marketing career \- join HGA's Marketing team!**
Locations: **Santa Monica, CA, Boston, MA or Washington, DC**  

As a nationally recognized architecture, engineering, and planning firm, we are seeking a **Marketing Coordinator** to support our marketing efforts within the **Healthcare sector**. If you're a creative, results\-driven marketer who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you!  

This individual will own the end\-to\-end process of managing pursuits, producing marketing collateral, coordinating field marketing, and developing HGA stories to inspire action. From brainstorming ideas and writing content to producing proposals and award submittals, we’re looking for someone who can help us target and win more specific clients and projects. **In this role you will:**  

* Lead the end\-to\-end process – project management, content development, and document production – for marketing collateral for client prepositioning and pursuits, specifically: RFQ/P Responses including qualifications packages, proposals, and interviews that integrate creative storytelling and visual delivery.
* Collaborate with Healthcare practice group leaders, principals, and business developers to implement messaging strategy, define narrative approach, and write/proof copy for marketing content.
* Develop high\-quality marketing content and collateral to support other marketing initiatives including project awards submissions, conferences, social media, speaking engagements, and publication advertising.
* Coordinate external (events, conferences, photoshoots) marketing activities and produce corresponding marketing collateral.
* Work in a highly interactive and cross\-functional position, collaborating and cultivating positive relationships with multiple team members across various teams and offices.
* Partner with the National Marketing and Communications team on the execution of strategic initiatives and champion marketing projects across teams as appropriate.
* Take initiative with a solution\-focused mindset with an ability to work in ambiguity and pivot through the unexpected.

 **You will need to have:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Art History (or other related field) or a relevant combination of experience, education, and training.
* 2\-5 years of professional experience writing marketing content, creating marketing collateral in Adobe InDesign, and managing multiple marketing projects from beginning to end.
* Experience managing and producing RFQ/P responses in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry preferred, ideally with a Healthcare focus.
* Exceptional aptitude in Adobe InDesign and proficiency with other Adobe Creative Suite programs (Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Proficiency in Adobe Workfront, Canva, and/or VantagePoint is a plus.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Proofreading, editing and standardizing proposal text for proper grammar, spelling, comprehension and style while adhering to brand standardizations.
* High attention to detail is critical.
* Ability to work in a team and independently, self\-starter and able to multitask workload to meet deadlines.
* Mentorship experience.
* Knowledge of Healthcare industry; building types, common healthcare verbiage, etc.

 **Salary information:**  

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short\- and long\-term disability programs. Salary Range: $88,200 \- $101,400 (East and West Coast) **depending on qualifications and experience.** **Additional information:**  

At HGA, you’ll do the best work of your career. We design with impact by diving deep into the people and passions that shape every place. Empathy fuels us, curiosity drives us, and meaningful work leads to innovation. We celebrate individuality, embrace flexibility, and thrive together in the office three days a week.  

Join our nationally recognized, award\-winning team of architects and engineers—and help us shape what’s next.  

Learn more about us **here****.** **Application Requirements \& Instructions**  

Please submit resume for consideration.

jobs.title: Client Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Tax Titans**


Tax Titans helps individuals and businesses navigate tax challenges with clarity and confidence. Our team reviews each client’s unique situation, explains the available options, and develops a personalized strategy to help resolve outstanding tax matters. From tax investigation and compliance to resolution services, we’re committed to providing honest guidance, responsive support, and a straightforward path forward.

 **Client Success Coordinator**  

Tax Titans \| Sherman Oaks, CA \| Full\-time, in\-office

 **About the role**  

Tax Titans helps individuals and businesses resolve IRS and state tax problems. The Client Success Coordinator keeps active cases moving from signed client to resolution. You'll be the main point of contact for existing clients. That means collecting what we need, keeping files complete and current, and making sure every client is set up for the right outcome. You'll work closely with sales, tax professionals, and leadership.

 **Key responsibilities**

*Client outreach and case preparation*

* Reach out to existing clients to collect documents and information needed to move their cases forward
* Schedule and complete financial statements (e.g., Form 433\-A) to prepare cases for resolution and identify additional service opportunities
* Make sure all required documents are in place, including authorizations, agreements, and supporting forms
* Provide regular status updates to active clients
* Proactively request reviews and referrals from existing clients to drive company growth and reputation

*Client support*

* Manage inbound client calls, texts, and emails, and resolve or route inquiries promptly
* Serve as first point of contact on cancellation and refund requests, escalating to leadership before anything is processed
* Support the sales and resolution teams as needed to move clients through each stage

*Payments*

* Follow up on declined or defaulted payments and work with clients to get accounts current
* Monitor payment plans and flag at\-risk accounts

*Case management*

* Monitor the virtual mailbox, upload new tax notices and correspondence to client files, and alert assigned team members
* Track deadlines for notice responses, document requests, and agreement payments
* Keep client records, notes, and statuses up to date in the CRM
* Review new cases at handoff from sales to confirm scope, fees, and file setup are accurate
* Take on other operational and client\-facing tasks as the team grows

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years in customer service, client success, or case management (tax, financial, or legal experience a plus)
* Strong phone and written communication skills; calm and clear with frustrated clients
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage many open files and deadlines at once
* Comfortable collecting sensitive financial information professionally and confidentially
* Experience with a CRM and phone/texting platforms preferred
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable owning a process end to end
  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

25 \- 25 USD per hour(Sherman Oaks, CA)

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
HiveWatch is a tech\-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we’re solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we’re building.


HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less “noise”, we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe.

**THE ROLE:**
-------------


We're looking for an Account Manager to own a book of enterprise customers. You'll drive renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and make sure your customers get real, measurable value from HiveWatch's platform. You'll run the full post\-sale account lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, QBRs, renewals, and expansion. You'll partner with our Professional Services / Implementation team to keep complex onboardings on track, identify and close expansions, and represent the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering.


If you love building relationships, connecting customer goals to what our platform can do, and running a tight renewal process end to end, this is your role.


Note: This is a full\-time, in\-person role at our HQ in El Segundo, CA. We are on\-site Tuesday through Thursday at our HQ, with flex remote days Mondays and Fridays.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
-------------------

**Own the account relationship**

* Manage a portfolio customer accounts as the primary point of contact for renewals, contract terms, and expansions
* Multithread across each account: identify and build relationships with new stakeholders as champions shift roles or leave
* Lead regular QBRs that connect customer goals to concrete outcomes

**Drive renewals and growth**

* Own a strong renewal motion end to end: forecasting, negotiation, and close
* Dig into each account to find where HiveWatch delivers value, and state that value in clear, concrete terms your customer can act on
* Identify, pursue, and close upsell, and cross\-sell opportunities across your book

**Lead onboarding and delivery**

* Ensure complex onboardings move through implementation on schedule, coordinating closely with Implementation
* Bring account leadership and project management skills to every stage of the customer journey, keeping timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables aligned

**Advocate internally**

* Communicate product feedback clearly and consistently to Product and Engineering
* Build strong internal relationships across Sales, Implementation, and Product

Account Manager \- Orange County  

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Account Manager oversees day\-to\-day operations and service delivery for multiple CSG client locations throughout Orange County. This is a hands\-on, field\-based leadership role requiring regular travel between assigned sites and a strong presence with clients, employees, and operational teams.


The Account Manager serves as the primary operational contact for assigned accounts, ensuring service expectations are met, staffing levels are maintained, employees are supported, and operations are conducted safely and efficiently.


Success in this role requires hospitality experience, strong client service and leadership skills, the ability to manage multiple locations and priorities, and effective communication in both English and Spanish.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned accounts and build strong relationships with client representatives.

* Understand each account’s scope of work, staffing requirements, schedules, service expectations, and client procedures.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor service quality, staffing, cleanliness, safety, and overall performance.
* Respond promptly to client requests, concerns, and service issues and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership and direction to employees and supervisors assigned to client locations.

* Ensure required operational reports, inspections, and documentation are completed accurately and on time.

* Partner with Operations, Human Resources, Safety, Risk Management, and other CSG departments as needed to support employees and client accounts.

------------------

* Experience leading employees and managing day\-to\-day service operations.
* Strong client service, relationship management, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client locations and competing priorities.
* Experience with scheduling, timekeeping, labor management, and/or budget\-related reporting.
* Strong organizational and verbal and written communication skills.

This is a field\-based position requiring regular travel between assigned client locations throughout Orange County. Schedule flexibility is required based on client and operational needs and may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

The position requires regular movement throughout client properties, including extended periods of sitting, standing, and walking, as well as bending, reaching, stooping, pushing, pulling, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Work may be performed in indoor and outdoor hospitality and service environments. Reasonable accommodation may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Contract Services Group, Inc. (CSG) specializes in providing cleaning and related services to a variety of industry facilities throughout the Southwestern United States. * Ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
* Able to spend long periods of time at a computer station.
* Able to respond quickly to tight deadlines.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.


**Why Join Us?**

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Associate Account Manager \- West Hollywood**

  

**Introduction to the team:**

The Associate Account Manager’s primary responsibility is to develop and maintain a high\-quality portfolio of relevant, attractive, and competitive hotel and property products for Expedia Group’s fast\-growing global traveler base. The Associate Market Manager works with lodging partners within their assigned territory to help maximize the production potential in the marketplace.  



  

**Make an impact!**

The Account Management team ensures that global travelers always find the most suitable property for their dream trip and that hotel partners can reach Expedia Group’s full breadth of global traveler demand  



  

**In this role, you will:**

* Develop and sustain strong partnerships by providing relevant data insights and high\-quality needs\-based consulting services to hotel partners (e.g. revenue management advice, marketing opportunities on the Expedia Group marketplace)
* Ensure that partner hotels’ products (content, rates, and availability) are consistently optimized on Expedia Group sites to maximize customer conversion
* Secure additional lodging rates and availability information over high demand and compression periods to satisfy traveler needs
* Secure deals and promotions to support the brands’ merchandising and marketing efforts
* Continuously promote and develop hotel partners’ high engagement with Expedia Group’s full suite of:
	+ Unique market insights (partner reports, competitive data, key performance drivers)
	+ In\-house revenue management tools (Rev\+)
	+ Marketing and merchandising opportunities (dynamic promotions, packages, member deals, mobile offers)
	+ Specialized brands (e.g. Hotwire, Media Solutions) potential opportunities
	+ Self\-service tools (Expedia Partner Central)
* Execute effectively based on KPI metrics (targets, goals, and/or strategic objectives)
* Guide and support Hotel Partners to deliver the best traveler experience
* Promote self\-service
* Conduct regular self\-learning to improve skills
Travel for partner visits 0\-20% of the time  
* 

  

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 0\-2 years of experience in account management, partner/client success, consultative sales, or related field
* Proficient in English language skills
* Passionate about travel
* Work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team
* Possess a strong appetite for innovative technology, a fast\-changing business environment, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Prioritize and multi\-task effectively to achieve critical targets, goals, and/or strategic objectives set by TPM leadership team
* Continue to follow up when facing testing situations
* Present ideas and directives clearly and persuasively, both written and verbally
* Demonstrate analytical skills with market trends, partner performance, and competitor analysis to address business and partner needs
* Proactively and consistently demonstrate the unique value proposition of partnering with Expedia Group
* Possess a growth mindset, consistently using feedback to improve in role
* Relationship builder; earns the confidence of others. Bridges and sustains solid partnerships based on mutual support through a collaborative style
Drive for results  
* 

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in Beverly Hills is $70,000\.00 to $98,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $112,000\.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.\&\#xa;  

  

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.  



  

**Benefits and perks**

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .  



  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information

jobs.title: GCP Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III), you will support Public Sector customers with cloud adoption, operational planning, technical issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination. Working alongside senior team members, you will help maintain account health and coordinate activities across customer and delivery partner teams. You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. Our teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms, improve mission\-critical operations, and create business value through scalable engineering solutions. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.
* Must currently hold a Google Cloud Professional certification in at least one of the following: Professional Cloud Architect; Professional Cloud Database Engineer; Professional Cloud Developer; Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer; Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Professional Cloud Security Engineer; Professional Data Engineer; Professional Machine Learning Engineer; or Professional Security Operations Engineer.
* Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 to $170,000\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Hi, We're Centerfield!**


Supercharged customer acquisition. Centerfield delivers outcome\-based digital marketing solutions and personalized omnichannel experiences for the world’s leading brands. Powered by our proprietary Dugout platform, Centerfield acquires customers at scale for leading residential service, insurance, e\-commerce, and B2B brands. Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as **Business.com** and **BroadbandNow.com**, reach more than 150 million in\-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.

**The Opportunity...**
----------------------


Centerfield is seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Client Success Manager to join our fast\-paced team! In this role, you’ll support the onboarding, management, and growth of our Direct Brands across the Savings.com and Brainjolt platforms, contributing to meaningful impact in a rapidly growing industry. As a CSM, you’ll partner with some of the largest retail and e\-tail brands that sell through e\-commerce platforms such as Amazon and Walmart. You’ll be supported by a community of experts, industry\-leading AI technology, and one of the largest online audiences to help drive measurable sales growth for clients This is a dynamic, ever\-changing space—perfect for someone who’s eager to learn, curious about digital commerce, and excited to grow their career in Client Success. You don’t need years of experience; what matters most is your strong communication skills, proactive mindset, and passion for supporting clients.

**How You'll Contribute...**
----------------------------

* Have a plan! Manage a book of business with a focus on renewals, growth, and long\-term success with focus on onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement that deliver tangible ROI and maximize customer satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Scores (NPS)
* Be the resident expert (in progress)! Learn each client’s goals, programs, and performance metrics while building knowledge of Centerfield’s solutions, tools, and industry terminology so you can engage clients with confidence
* Get out there! Support client growth by spotting opportunities to add value, sharing product offerings with guidance from senior team members, and contributing to upsell and cross\-sell initiatives that drive revenue
* Be a partner in growth! Support clients in achieving their goals by fostering strong relationships, helping them see value quickly, and contributing to Client advocacy opportunities like case studies, testimonials, or peer networking
* Track what matters! Define, monitor, and report on KPIs for each client program. Attend regular client meetings (weekly or bi\-weekly) to review objectives, progress, and results, while hosting internal meetings as needed to align teams
* Own the details! Maintain organized tracking of projects and deliverables, ensuring clarity of goals, timely execution, and compliance with internal controls and procedures
* Solve challenges! Flag escalations to senior team members as you learn to address complex client needs with resourcefulness, collaboration, and creative problem\-solving
* Speak up! Provide feedback and insights to leadership to inform product innovation, enhance offerings, and support the company’s growth
* Leverage your tools! Utilize Salesforce, Looker, AI tools, and internal platforms to manage client engagement, maintain accurate records, and ensure smooth communication across teams
* Show the results! Alongside leadership, prepare compelling presentations and reports for client partnership meetings, highlighting progress, ROI, and opportunities for further growth

**What We're Looking For...**
-----------------------------

* 1\+ years of Client/Customer success, account management, or similar experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent experience.
* It’s a plus if you bring: Familiarity with digital and affiliate marketing, including paid media.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Nice to have, but not required: experience in Salesforce, Notion, Looker and AI tools like Claude.
* Analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies.
* Ability to learn quickly and break down complex ideas into clear action steps.
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities with good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and willingness to seek guidance or resources to find solutions.
* Clear communicator with solid written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
* Curious and creative thinker who’s open to rolling up their sleeves and trying new approaches.
* Self\-starter who can take initiative while also working well in a collaborative team environment.
* Positive team player with a strong sense of accountability and a “can\-do” attitude.
* Responsible and motivated, able to stay focused in a fast\-paced environment.
* Organized and detail\-oriented, ensuring tasks and documentation are completed accurately.
* Operates with integrity, honesty, and fairness in all interactions.
* Flexibility to adjust work hours for client meetings across time zones.

**Life at Centerfield...**
--------------------------

* **This is a hybrid position, and employees are expected to come into our Playa Vista, CA office every Tuesday, Wednesday \& Thursday**
* Competitive salary \+ semi\-annual bonus
* Unlimited PTO – take a break when you need it!
* Industry\-leading medical, dental, and vision plans \+ generous parental leave
* 401(k) company match plan – fully vested on day 1
* Outside patio overlooking Playa Vista \+ cabanas, firepits \& working grills
* Award\-winning culture \& unprecedented team spirit (featured in LA Business Journal \& Built In LA)
* Fully stocked kitchens with snacks \& drinks
* Breakroom supplied with games, couches, workout equipment \+ weekl

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Outlandish Inc.** is a fast\-growing social commerce company and TikTok Shop Partner Agency helping brands, creators, and businesses grow through TikTok Shop, livestreaming, creator partnerships, content, and e\-commerce strategy.

We operate in a fast\-paced, highly creative environment where social media is at the center of what we do. We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager** who understands internet culture, knows what makes content perform, and can help build and grow the Outlandish brand across social platforms.

**About the Role:**

As our **Social Media Manager**, you will own and help execute Outlandish's day\-to\-day social media presence. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can think strategically while also jumping in to create, film, edit, post, and analyze content.

You should have a strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, be comfortable identifying trends and turning ideas into engaging content quickly, and understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance.

We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow trends, you understand why content works and can use performance data, audience behavior, and creative testing to continuously improve our social presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute Outlandish's overall social media strategy across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Own and maintain the social media content calendar, including planning, scheduling, publishing, and coordinating content.
* Create engaging short\-form content from concept through execution, including filming, editing, writing captions, and publishing.
* Develop creative concepts, hooks, scripts, recurring content series, and social campaigns that align with the Outlandish brand.
* Stay highly informed on TikTok, Instagram, creator economy, e\-commerce, social commerce, and internet trends.
* Identify relevant trends and quickly determine how they can be adapted authentically for the Outlandish brand.
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content from our team, offices, livestream studios, creators, events, and company initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify stories, projects, events, milestones, and educational opportunities that can become social content.
* Manage community engagement, including comments, messages, mentions, and opportunities to interact with our audience.
* Monitor social media performance and track KPIs including reach, views, engagement, follower growth, watch time, click\-through rates, and other relevant metrics.
* Use performance data to identify what is and isn't working and make recommendations for future content.
* Continuously test different hooks, formats, posting strategies, creative concepts, and content styles.
* Help strengthen and maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across platforms.
* Monitor competitors and industry leaders to identify emerging trends, content opportunities, and best practices.
* Support social coverage for company events, creator activations, livestreams, and other special projects as needed.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, including platform culture, trends, algorithms, and content best practices.
* Hands\-on experience creating short\-form video content for TikTok, Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
* Comfortable filming content using a phone or camera and editing short\-form videos.
* Experience with editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar platforms.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and what keeps viewers watching.
* Ability to write engaging, platform\-appropriate captions and social copy.

**Position Summary**


The Defense Systems Division is part of the Parker Aerospace Group, located in Irvine, California. Our products are used across military and commercial platforms globally. We specialize in cutting edge thermal management systems and components including fans, pumps and compressors, ammunition handling systems, weapon scoring systems, dynamic pressure sensors, piezoelectric accelerometers, towed targets, reeling machines, and associated telemetry.


For over fifty years, we have been a leader in defense products, contributing to the operational success of some of the most advanced military platforms worldwide.


As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.  



JOB SUMMARY


The role of the import and export coordinator is crucial in managing the import and export logistics and documentation involved in the international import and export of shipments of US export\-controlled goods (subject to EAR and ITAR licensing) at the manufacturing site by implementing appropriate work procedures and responsible for the movement of merchandise in/out of the country in compliance with all federal, Customs and local regulations.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

* Coordinate and manage the import and export clearance process, including preparing accurate shipping documentation, customs declaration and compliance with Federal and Customs regulations.
* Perform as the central point of contact for export and import customs transactions at the manufacturing site.
* Interface with freight forwarders, Customs brokers, and other import and export related parties as appropriate to ensure compliance with procedures and regulations.
* Preparing and maintaining export and import documentation.
* Submit Electronic Export Information (EEI) to ACE Portal for export transactions.
* Monitor shipments from origin to destination, resolving any issues that may arise during transit.
* Monitor import and export license utilization, decrement, and closure.
* Collaborate with Customs brokers to ensure timely clearance of imported goods.
* Assist Trade Compliance Officer in determining jurisdiction and import\-export classification for goods and technologies, including Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) codes, U.S. Munition List numbers (USML) and Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCN) and developing classification decision rationale, heuristics and methodology for various product lines to improve efficiency in classification while maintaining accuracy.
* Support MRO team \- issue MRO and coordinate shipments of 9801 US goods return.
* Accurately maintain import and export related transaction records and logs, including but not limited to import/export clearance records, contract document, export license and freight/duty record, etc.
* Timely audit customs entries (7501\) for correctness and conformity with appropriate documents and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Associate’s degree (A.A.) along with 2\+ years related experience and/or training. Bachelor's degree in business, engineering or related technical field preferred.

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator \- Document Control**


**Location:** San Jose, CA, United States — 100% On\-Site  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried \| Project\-based assignment scheduled through Q3 2028  

**Schedule:** Full\-time at the project site  

✈️ **Travel:** Minimal; occasional local travel within Santa Clara County  

**Salary Range:** $80,000–$100,000 annually (based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications; base salary only)  

**Benefits:** 100% Employer Paid Medical, Dental, Vision \| 401(k) Match \| PTO \& Holidays \| Paid Lunch \| Commuter Benefit

 **About Us**


SK AX USA, Inc. delivers specialized IT, infrastructure, and digital transformation services across the United States. We support large\-scale, mission\-critical programs involving advanced infrastructure, operational technology, and next\-generation AI environments.


For this program, we represent the owner’s technology organization, translating AI infrastructure requirements into facility specifications and verifying that construction meets those requirements.


**Learn more:** https://www.skaxusa.com/

 **Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator \- Document Control** to oversee project documentation and support on\-site coordination for a large\-scale AI data center construction program in San Jose, California.


As one of three full\-time resident staff members, you will own the document control function and coordinate the flow of information among the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator. The program spans four construction phases through Q3 2028\.


Your responsibilities will include revision control, submittal tracking, meeting coordination, inspection and commissioning records, permitting documentation, and project turnover. You will ensure project information remains accurate, current, traceable, and accessible throughout the program.


This role requires hands\-on ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across organizations while working closely with project leadership and technical teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Document Control \& Configuration Management**

* Maintain version and revision control for drawings, specifications, technical requirements, and interface control documents.
* Manage document issuance and distribution, track approval status, and ensure teams can clearly identify the current revision.
* Publish and maintain the configuration register weekly.
* Issue revision notices to affected stakeholders and maintain a traceable record of document changes.

 **Multi\-Party Submittal Coordination**

* Receive, register, and distribute deliverables from the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator.
* Maintain a daily submittal intake register and monitor outstanding or overdue deliverables.
* Follow up with responsible parties and escalate delays before they affect project milestones.
* Flag inconsistencies between organizations’ documents for review by the technical team.

 **Meeting Coordination \& Action Tracking**

* Coordinate approximately 10–15 recurring and ad hoc meetings per month, including contractor coordination meetings, owner reviews, and phase gate sessions.
* Prepare and distribute agendas and pre\-read materials.
* Produce and distribute meeting minutes within two business days.
* Maintain action item registers, including responsible owners, due dates, and closure evidence.
* Follow up on open actions and escalate overdue items to project leadership.

 **Inspection \& Commissioning Records**

* Document factory testing, site testing, and integrated system testing activities, including attendance, observations, photographs, and test reports.
* Maintain non\-conformance report (NCR) and punch list registers through closure.
* Assemble evidence packages supporting the owner’s technical acceptance assessments at each phase gate.
* Coordinate with engineering and field teams to maintain complete, traceable inspection and commissioning records.

 **Permitting Documentation**

* Compile and track permit submittal packages.
* Log comments, correction requests, and outstanding conditions from permitting authorities.
* Maintain approval histories and communicate documentation status to the project team.

 **As\-Built Documentation \& Project Turnover**

* Receive and catalog as\-built drawings and operations and maintenance (O\&M) documentation.
* Track documentation completeness and follow up on missing or incomplete submissions.
* Maintain the turnover deficiency list through project closeout.
* Organize final documentation packages for handover to the owner.

*Technical review and acceptance of as\-built documents remain the responsibility of the engineering team. This position manages document receipt, cataloging, and completeness tracking.*

 **Qualifications**

 **Required Experience**

* Three or more years of document control experience on construction or data center projects.
* Hands\-on experience with an electronic document management system such as Procore, Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or an equivalent platform.
* Demonstrated experience preparing meeting minutes and tracking action items in a technical environment.
* Ability to follow engineering discussions and accurately summarize decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.

 **Technical \& Language Skills**

* Professional fluency in both English and Korean is required. English is used daily with contractors, consultants, and vendors; Korean is used daily with the owner’s technology organization and headquarters.
* Strong capability in document revision control, approval tracking, and records management.
* Ability to organize technical documentation and maintain accurate registers across multiple project stakeholders.

 **Communication \& Coordination Skills**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are \& Why This Role Matters:**

Copia Resources CA, Inc. isn’t just another company. We are building an empire in the environmental services industry. If you’re looking for a cushy 9\-to\-5 where you can coast, this isn’t for you. We move fast, we solve problems, and we don’t settle for “good enough.”

We’re looking for an Operations Coordinator who will serve as the day\-to\-day owner of the client experience. From the moment a request or concern is received through final resolution, this person will coordinate the necessary internal action, communicate proactively with the client, document all commitments, and confirm that every issue has been fully resolved. You’ll be the connection between our clients, Customer Service team, field teams, and internal departments, ensuring everyone stays aligned, informed, and accountable.

If you’re proactive, solution\-oriented, and focused on delivering an exceptional client experience, this position is a perfect fit.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Customer Service Operations \& Client Support**

* Take ownership of client requests, concerns, and service issues from initial contact through final resolution, ensuring nothing is delayed, overlooked, or left incomplete.
* Coordinate the necessary action across Customer Service, Field Operations, Sales, Accounting, BPO representatives, haulers, vendors, and other internal or external partners.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for clients by setting clear expectations and providing proactive updates throughout the resolution process.
* Track commitments, deadlines, responsible parties, and next steps to ensure all internal and external follow\-up is completed accurately and on time.
* Confirm that the requested work has been completed, verify that the client’s concern has been addressed, and close the communication loop with everyone involved.
* Document client communications, decisions, commitments, and resolutions accurately in Salesforce.
* Identify unresolved issues, service failures, communication gaps, and at\-risk client relationships and escalate them promptly to the Customer Service Manager.
* Support client onboarding, service changes, and other client\-facing activities by coordinating requirements across departments.

**Customer Service Team Support \& Performance Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary support resource for BPO customer service representatives by providing guidance on processes, customer inquiries, escalation handling, and operational challenges.
* Help maintain consistency across the customer service team by supporting training, reviewing workflows, and identifying opportunities to improve team performance.
* Review customer interactions and Salesforce cases to ensure quality, accuracy, documentation, and adherence to company standards.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including response times, case quality, communication standards, and overall team effectiveness.
* Provide performance insights, trends, and recommendations to the Operations Manager during regular check\-ins.
* Support training initiatives, process updates, and continuous improvement efforts within the customer service team.

**Field Operations Support \& Communication**

* Maintain consistent communication with Route Supervisors, Area Managers, and field teams to support daily operational needs.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for field\-related questions, service challenges, scheduling concerns, and communication needs.
* Coordinate communication between Customer Service and Field Operations to ensure timely issue resolution and operational alignment.
* Identify recurring field\-related challenges and partner with Operations leadership to develop solutions that improve service consistency.
* Escalate significant operational concerns, safety issues, service risks, and recurring challenges to the Operations Manager.
* Support efforts to improve communication, collaboration, and information sharing between office teams and field operations.
* Location: San Ramon, CA (This is NOT a remote position).
* Work Schedule: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced environment requiring strong organization, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, field teams, and internal departments.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and confidence.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable taking ownership of issues and driving them through resolution.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting remote teams, BPO teams, or customer service teams preferred.
* Environmental services, waste, logistics, transportation, or field operations experience preferred.
* Travel Requirement: Regular local and regional travel to client sites and company locations is required, with occasional out\-of\-state or international travel as needed.
* Must have a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the ability to travel as required.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Compensation: $75,000 per year.
* 401(k) with company match
* Medical, dental, vision insurance
* Paid time off

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* You’ll lead a high\-performing team that’s redefining service excellence in the waste management industry.
* You’ll be challenged daily — to think bigger, move faster, and make things better.
* You’ll be part of a company that’s growing rapidly, creating room for you to grow your career with us.
* You’ll have real impact — every process you improve and every person you develop contributes directly to our success.

Pay: $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

jobs.description:
**About Asociación Mayab:**

Asociación Mayab is a non\-profit organization committed to the growth and well\-being of the Yucatec community in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Headquartered in San Francisco, we provide critical social services and emergency support to Maya immigrant families. In addition to our social services, we work diligently to preserve and promote Yucatec Maya culture and serve as a bridge between our community, local authorities, consulates, and the Mexican Yucatecan governments. Our mission is to foster community participation, encourage cultural exchange, and support economic development for Yucatecan immigrants in the Bay Area and their home communities. Through our programs and initiatives, we aim to strengthen the Yucatec Maya cultural values and promote access to essential services for our community members.

**Job Overview**

Asociación Mayab is seeking an experienced, university\-educated professional to provide high\-quality case management services and build strong relationships with community organizations, universities, government agencies and service providers. The ideal candidate must communicate clearly, confidently and naturally in professional English and Spanish. Excellent writing skills are required for formal letters, case notes, reports, referrals, emails and other official communications.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Education, Teaching, Sociology or a related field.
* Teachers with a bachelor's degree and other university\-educated professionals are encouraged to apply.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience working with families, students, community members,
* social\-service programs or case\-management services.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English and Spanish.
* Ability to write clear and professional letters, reports, case notes, referrals, emails and official communications.
* Strong public\-speaking, outreach and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, electronic databases and case\-management systems.
* Excellent organization, confidentiality, professional judgment and follow\-through.
* Three verifiable professional references.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Interview participants and assess individual and family needs.
* Develop individualized service and follow\-up plans.
* Connect participants with health, mental\-health, housing, legal, educational, employment and social\-service resources.
* Prepare professional case notes, formal letters, referrals, reports and correspondence.
* Maintain complete, accurate and confidential physical and electronic files.
* Follow each case through resolution, referral or appropriate closure.
* Communicate professionally with clients, attorneys, hospitals, agencies and service providers.
* Conduct outreach and represent Asociación Mayab at meetings, presentations and community events.
* Establish professional relationships with universities, nonprofit organizations, government agencies and community partners.
* Invite partner organizations to provide services and participate in Asociación Mayab programs and activities.
* Prepare regular reports and provide timely updates to the Executive Director.

We are seeking an ethical, compassionate, dependable and highly organized professional who can work independently and represent Asociación Mayab with confidence and professionalism.

**Application Materials**

* Current résumé
* Cover letter
* Confirmation of university degree
* Three professional references

Pay: $25\.45 \- $30\.65 per hour

* Do you have a bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Education, Teaching, Sociology or a related field?
* Do you have at least five years of relevant professional experience working with families, students, community members, social\-service programs or case\-management services?
* Are you professionally fluent in spoken and written English and Spanish?
* Can you prepare professional letters, reports, case notes, referrals, emails and official communications?
* Do you have experience completing assessments, service plans, referrals and case follow\-up?
* Can you provide three verifiable professional references?
