jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Live Event Producer \& Production Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Staffing Program Manager

**FLSA STATUS:** Full Time, Salaried, Exempt

***Job Summary:*** 

We are seeking a Live Event Producer \& Production Coordinator to join our live production team supporting a portfolio of in\-person, broadcast, virtual, and hybrid experiences.

This role combines independent live event production with production coordination across larger programs. The right candidate will own assigned recurring and mid\-scale live productions from initial planning through execution and wrap, while also partnering with Senior Producers and Executive Producers to support larger and more complex events.

This person should be highly organized, comfortable working in a fast\-moving live production environment, and capable of moving between leading their own show and supporting another producer's project. They should understand live event and broadcast production, communicate effectively with stakeholders and technical teams, and take ownership of the details required to keep a production moving.

This is a hands\-on production role for an experienced producer who can independently own productions while continuing to expand their experience across larger\-scale programs.

***What Success Looks Like:***

A successful person in this role can be trusted to independently own a recurring live program while also making the producers around them more effective. They keep production details organized, anticipate what is needed next, communicate clearly, close loops, and escalate issues before they become problems.

Over time, they should be able to take on increasingly complex productions and larger areas of ownership while maintaining strong production fundamentals, attention to detail, and consistency.

***Essential Functions:*** 

**Live Event Production** 

* Independently produce assigned live events, broadcasts, recurring programs, and other live experiences from pre\-production through onsite execution and post\-production wrap.
* Serve as the primary production point of contact for assigned programs, partnering with stakeholders, content teams, technical teams, and vendors.
* Develop and maintain production plans, timelines, run of show documents, rehearsal schedules, call sheets, production schedules, and other show documentation.
* Lead production meetings, technical discussions, rehearsals, speaker preparation, tech checks, and show\-day execution for assigned programs.
* Coordinate with Technical Directors, show callers, stage managers, broadcast engineers, streaming teams, AV partners, and other production personnel.
* Manage production logistics including crew coordination, equipment needs, talent logistics, travel, credentials, production spaces, and onsite requirements.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and outstanding decisions throughout the production lifecycle.
* Build, track, and reconcile production budgets, including vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoices, and final project reconciliation.
* Ensure productions follow established brand standards, production workflows, safety requirements, rights and releases, and technical best practices.
* Participate in post\-production reviews, document learnings, and ensure project files and assets are properly archived.

**Production Coordination \& Team Support** 

* Partner with Senior Producers and Executive Producers on larger\-scale events and broadcasts, providing production management and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
* Own defined workstreams within larger productions, taking responsibility for deliverables and follow\-through rather than providing administrative support alone.
* Build and maintain master production schedules, project trackers, action\-item lists, staffing plans, production calendars, and other project documentation.
* Coordinate project meetings, capture decisions and action items, and proactively follow up with owners to keep projects on schedule.
* Support vendor onboarding, estimates, contracts, purchase orders, invoicing, travel, credentials, crew logistics, and other production operations.
* Coordinate production assets and information across creative, technical, broadcast, event, post\-production, and stakeholder teams.
* Maintain accurate information within production management systems and ensure project documentation remains current and accessible.
* Assist producers with onsite production operations including rehearsals, backstage coordination, talent movement, technical checks, production office management, and show execution.
* Identify missing information, schedule risks, and production dependencies early and work with the appropriate producer or production lead to resolve them.
* Provide additional production support across the team's portfolio as priorities and production schedules shift.

***Required Skills \& Abilities:*** 

* Strong understanding of live event production workflows including pre\-production, technical planning, rehearsals, show execution, and post\-production wrap.
* Working knowledge of production budgets, vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoicing, budget tracking, and final reconciliation.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with producers, technical teams, vendors, stakeholders, executives, talent, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to follow through on assignments without requiring constant oversight.
* Comfortable working onsite in live production environments and adapting quickly when schedules or production requirements change.
* Ability to identify production risks, missing information, and dependencies early and proactively drive them toward resolution.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Google

jobs.title: Admissions & Programs Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**


We have an exciting full\-time opportunity for an **Admissions \& Program Operations Coordinator** at El Chante, our licensed 20\-bed residential substance use treatment program serving adult men in Oakland, Alameda County.


This role serves as the primary administrative liaison for all admissions into the residential Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program. This position is responsible for coordinating referrals, admissions, discharges, bed management, census reporting, and client appointment scheduling while ensuring compliance with agency, county, and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with the Clinical Program Manager, SUD Counselors, Resident Monitors, referral partners, county partners, medical and housing partners, and agency leadership, the Coordinator helps ensure seamless client movement through the program while maximizing residential capacity and supporting high\-quality service delivery. This collaboration ensures timely admissions, efficient bed management, effective communication, and a coordinated client experience from referral through discharge.


This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The successful candidate will uphold and champion the agency's mission, vision, and values while contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and client\-centered work environment.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Admissions/Intake Coordination:**
===================================

* Serves as the central point of contact for all referrals and admissions into the residential program.
* Receive and coordinate referrals from all approved referral sources.
* Schedule client intake appointments based on bed availability and program capacity.
* Confirm admission dates and times with referral partners.
* Coordinate client transportation and drop\-off times to El Chante, as appropriate.
* Communicate admission instructions to referral sources, clients, and family members when appropriate.
* Monitor the intake schedule to ensure efficient utilization of available beds.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Program Manager and clinical staff regarding admission priorities and clinical considerations.

**Resident Census and Discharge Management:**
=============================================

* Maintains accurate and up\-to\-date information regarding all client admissions and discharges.
* Tracks all scheduled admissions.
* Monitors anticipated discharge dates.
* Coordinates discharge information with internal staff and referral partners.
* Updates admission and discharge logs.
* Communicates changes in bed availability to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains accurate census information to support operational planning.

**Bed Management and Census Reporting:**
========================================

* Maintain accurate daily census information and complete required reporting related to residential capacity.
* Completing daily bed surveys.
* Maintaining the Daily Bed Day Sheet.
* Tracking occupied and available beds.
* Monitoring program census and bed utilization.
* Ensuring bed tracking documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
* Working with leadership to maximize occupancy while maintaining appropriate clinical placement.

**Client Scheduling and Administrative Coordination:**
======================================================

* Manage the daily administrative schedule for residential clients to ensure appointments are coordinated and communicated effectively.
* Coordinate and maintain schedules for:
* Court appearances.
* Medical appointments.
* Primary care visits.
* Dental appointments.
* Specialty medical appointments.
* Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) clinic visits.
* Behavioral health appointments.
* Other approved external appointments.
* Communicates daily schedules with Resident Monitors, SUD Counselors, and the Clinical Program Manager to support transportation planning, clinical programming, and continuity of care.

### **Administrative Support Responsibilities**

* Provide timely, professional administrative support during scheduled hours, including monitoring and responding to phone calls, email, Slack, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for El Chante, providing information to clients, referral partners, community agencies, and other stakeholders and supporting positive community relationships.
* Support admissions and census management, including responding to referrals, maintaining intake and census records, preparing admission packets, coordinating communication related to admissions, transfers, and discharges, and maintaining referral and tracking systems.
* Maintain accurate program, client, staff, and reporting records in systems including Smart Care, Clinician’s Gateway, Salesforce, Paycom, Google Drive, and other applicable databases. Generate required reports and support billing, DATAR, Medi\-Cal eligibility, service\-hour, bed\-day, and other contract reporting requirements.
* Maintain accurate and compliant client and personnel documentation, including charts, licenses, certifications, TB records, training records, staff IDs, NPI/CAQH information, and system access. Ensure documentation meets agency, contract, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements and coordinate with HR and QA as needed.
* Support staff onboarding and ongoing administrative needs, including system access, required training and certifications, Clinician’s Gateway authorizations, and training on internal systems and procedures.
* Coordinate and track facility operations, maintenance, supplies, deliveries, mail, faxes, equipment, technology, and maintenance requests to support a safe, organized, and fully operational residential environment.
* Support the therapeutic milieu by engaging appropriately with residents and assisting program staff with administrative and operational needs as appropriate.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring an **Event Marketing Manager** to own a segment for event marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.
* Work ethic that matches our pace – sleeves rolled up, high throughput, and clear prioritization.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

jobs.description:
**About Cogent**
----------------


Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. Since emerging from stealth, we’ve grown rapidly and partnered with global enterprises to secure some of the world’s most complex production environments.


Our product and talent are our biggest differentiators. Our team brings experience from:

* High growth technology companies including Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, and Coinbase.
* Leading cybersecurity companies including Wiz, Abnormal AI, and Zscaler.
* Preeminent machine learning research labs including DeepMind and SAIL.


Backed by Greylock and Bain Capital Ventures, we’re building a team that combines frontier AI research with deep cybersecurity expertise and the ability to execute at scale.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


Cogent is looking for a Channel Account Manager to build and grow our partner ecosystem across the Western US. You will own the regional channel strategy and be accountable for turning partner relationships into qualified pipeline and bookings.


This role is ideal for a cybersecurity channel leader who knows the Western partner ecosystem, is equally comfortable building strategy and working deals, and thrives in an early stage environment. This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and will cover the West, including Southern California, the Pacific Northwest, and Mountain/Southwest markets.

* 7\+ years in channel, alliances, or partner development, including 5\+ years in cybersecurity.

* Experience building focused partner plans, enabling sellers, and selling complex enterprise security solutions alongside partners.
* Strong commercial judgment, operating discipline, and comfort owning pipeline and bookings targets.
* High growth or challenger company experience, with the willingness to travel and operate hands on.

jobs.title: Account Manager- Optical Solutions
jobs.description:
**Your Job**
Molex is seeking an Account Manager who has experience working on server or switch system to support strategic leading enterprise customer in the data center market. At Molex we are leading the industry, with our advanced Datacom and Datacenter solutions to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this highly visible sales position, you will join a team of professionals who are passionate about delivering the best products in the world to the market.


**What You Will Do**


On field support key customer to design win key project and grow business by professional application service.

  

* Provide optimal interconnection solution according to customer's application scenarios and customized concept proposal in time according to customer's expectations
* Support new parts qualification by the customers. Figure out different conditions behind the specs between customers and Molex. The goal is to pass the qualification
* Resolve complex mechanical application related technical problems to meet customer needs
* Support failure analysis, especially for new win projects. Collect all related factors on\-site, coordinate with the Quality and Development team, allocate all resources to solve the failure

  

Keep close communications with key customers and feedback VOC to internal product marketing and design team.  

* Take notes to document external customer and internal meetings capturing technical specs, key take aways, action items and next steps. Publish to internal Molex and follow up to ensure completion and closure\-For both technical and commercial items
* Keep eyes on market trends, participate the market competition analysis
* Develop/seek new or advanced technologies in mechanical application support capabilities
* Disseminate/share customer information to Sales and Marketing team
* Build and maintain good relationship/trust with key engineers of customer
* Develop and advance relationships vertically and horizontally within the customer at all levels, "C" and below to capture the account 360 degrees
* Other duties as assigned by Management
* Engage with customers to achieve or surpass assigned revenue targets as well as assigned demand creation pipeline goals. Track and document these actions and results in our Customer Relationship Management tool (Salesforce).
* Find desirable revenue opportunities and present to Business Units for necessary support.
* Track and coordinate demand creation business transitioned to other parts of the world to assure Molex captures this business.
* Ongoing development of personal expertise is critical to success in this role.
* Become an expert in understanding this customer's individual strategic business plans.

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent
* At least 5 years of related R\&D experience on Server or Switch product for a degree holder

  

**What Will Put You Ahead*** Experience with fiber optic connectors

  

* Experience of application on connector and cable assembly.
* Knowledge of server or switch hardware/architecture
* 3D mechanical design tool
* Agile, problem\-solving mind\-set
* A self\-driven and well\-organized person with a high initiative and the ability to work independently.

  

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
For this role, we anticipate paying $130,000 \- $180,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

**Hiring Philosophy**


All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**


At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**Our Benefits**


Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.


Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Semiconductor
jobs.description:
**Join HARTING! A leader in connectivity products and custom solutions…..**


We are seeking a **Key Account Manager – Semiconductor** (Remote; based in the San Francisco Bay area, CA) to plan and execute business development activities to penetrate designated National and Key Accounts with the full range of HARTING products and technologies and achieve budgetary and medium term sales goals.


HARTING aims to be a trusted advisor to HARTING customers and positions itself as the go\-to source expert for industrial connectivity solutions. We partner directly with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Distribution partners for standard product, designed\-in value\-added products, and Product Development initiatives.

**To succeed in this role, you will be highly driven to:**

* Map network of manufacturing plants, design and decision making centers, supply chain methods, subcontractors, contract manufacturers and distributors associated with the designated, key accounts as well as new, developing markets.
* Evaluate the overall connectivity potential and determine the share of this potential by competitors on an on\-going basis.
* Propose and execute with management support, medium to long term penetration plans to maximize HARTING’s share of this potential and identify profitable new product development opportunities.
* Develop business relationships at the highest possible levels within both the Key Account as the major sub\-contractors, to cement the company to company relationships and early access to future business.
* Closely coordinate all project activity with both Market Development Management as well as with Product Management so as to ensure an efficient two way flow of information between HINA and the corporate divisions and departments regarding product development, evaluation of potentials and international coordination, as needed.
* Design in HARTING products in to Account’s equipment and automation lines by working closely with customer’s engineering and supply chain personnel in order to gain approval for corporate specifications or individual project approval.
* Review plans, and other customer and industry standards to develop and prepare cost effective solutions utilizing HARTING solutions.
* Analyze and propose changes in equipment, processes, or use of materials or services which would result in cost reduction or improvement in operation.
* Provide technical training to employees of client as needed.
* Prepares monthly reports to HARTING management on sales activity and forecasting monthly sales and prepare annual forecasts and medium term goals for planning purposes.
* Represent HARTING at tradeshows related to Account’s business.
* Maintain a timely and reliable record of all Account activity in CRM.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

 **Skills and experience to thrive in this role:**

* Bachelor’s of Science degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Electromechanical, Industrial Technology or other technical degree).
* 5\+ years of experience and/or training in technical solutions selling; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Prior knowledge and use of CRM, SAP preferred.
* Travel up to 30%

 ***HARTING Americas*** *is a subsidiary of HARTING Technology Group, a German\-based global leader in industrial connectivity solutions. We develop, manufacture, and sell the world's most durable and reliable products and solutions for use in Machinery \& Robotics, Automation Devices, Rail \& Transportation, Intralogistics \& Conveyor Systems, Energy, and Datacenter market segments.*

 *As a third generation, family\-owned company, with over 75 years of history,* *we continue to create value and shape the future with technologies for people**. You will discover that we work hard – to fulfill our personal, company, and customer goals, and in our commitment to our community with our holiday drives and our paid VTO (Voluntary Time Off). You will also discover that we like to have fun – like when we celebrate the holidays, host theme days and sweater parties, prost to Oktoberfest, and much more!*


Visit us on LinkedIn!

**HARTING USA offers an attractive total compensation package and employee benefits, including:**

**Compensation:**

* HARTING's Total Compensation Structure includes a Base Salary and Bonus Percentage.
* Competitive base salary: $140,000\-$175,000 (commensurate with experience, subject to change dependent on physical location)
* This role is eligible for a 20% discretionary annual bonus.

**Benefits:**

* 21 days PTO (Paid Time Off) to start – quickly earn more PTO as you stick with us (36 days max)
* Medical, dental, and vision Insurance – several Blue Cross Blue Shield plan options to choose from
* Company\-sponsored life, AD\&D, and short\- and long\-term disability – at no cost to employee.
* Paid parental leave, tuition and fitness reimbursement.
* 401(k) with a 4% dollar\-for\-dollar match – fully vested upon eligibility!

You will contribute to reliable, secure cloud outcomes in complex public\-sector environments. This remote role is available to candidates who can work from within the continental United States.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/21/2026\.

As a GCP Technical Account Manager (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer III) on the AI \& Engineering team, you will be responsible for:
  

* Coordinate technical activities across assigned customer workstreams and track customer issues, risks, dependencies, action items, and upcoming milestones.
* Collaborate with client Support, Product Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and customer escalations.
* Support customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, and operational readiness activities.
* Prepare materials for technical reviews, quarterly business reviews, and customer meetings; document customer needs and communicate product feedback to client teams.
* Recommend Google Cloud practices that improve adoption, reliability, security, and performance; escalate complex technical or customer issues to the Senior Technical Account Manager.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment

* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

At Deloitte, AI \& Engineering brings together engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated, sector\-focused solutions across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. We tailor our delivery approach to each client's priorities, operating environment, and transformation goals.

**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree or 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, software development, or technical consulting.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting customers with Google Cloud implementations, cloud transformation programs, technical support, customer launches, release management, escalations, or technical consulting.
* 1\+ years of experience designing, developing, supporting, or operating microservices, distributed systems, and application programming interfaces (APIs) using software development practices.

**Preferred:**  

* Experience supporting public\-sector customers in Google Cloud environments.
* Experience coordinating customer launches, capacity planning, product releases, or operational readiness activities.
* Experience preparing materials for technical reviews or quarterly business reviews.

jobs.description:
Come Join the Winning Team!
  
  

Carpenter \& Paterson, Inc. is currently hiring for an Outside Sales Representative to work out of our Corona, CA location, but working the surrounding areas. This position achieves maximum sales profitability, growth and account insight within a multi\-state territory in the northeast. Identifies solid market segment by effectively selling the company’s catalog and engineered pipe supports, as well our engineered designs and project management related to infrastructure projects. This sales position will also be responsible for personally contacting and securing new business accounts and customers.
  
  

**Essential Duties:**  

* Establish, develop, and maintain business relationships with current customers and prospective customers in order to generate new business for the organization’s products and services
* Respond to prospective customer inquiries and requests for quotations
* Perform business development calls, presentations, and related follow up
* Consult with builders on industrial building projects to ensure ideal placement of product
* Identify new business opportunities within distribution, end user targets, and large industrial projects
* Train end users on C\&P’s products and services
* Support existing product lines by fielding technical questions from customers
* Direct customer interface \- daily as well as one to two nights a week \- overnight travel is required
* Become technically proficient in customers’ applications as well as gain knowledge of new uses for existing products
* Participates in trade shows and conventions
* Other duties as assigned


**Ideal Candidate:**  

* Sales experience in pipe hangers, engineered pipe supports, industrial construction, wastewater projects, or other relative construction is a plus
* A commitment to our culture of teamwork and collaboration is essential
* Must have a valid driver’s license and a good driving record
* Good organizational skills and the ability to demonstrate solid sales strategy system.
* Above average verbal and written communication


**Hours:** 8:00am\-5:00pm
  
  

**Benefit Highlights:**  

* Weekly pay
* Competitive salary compensation
* 8 Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off
* Low affordable rates for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance as well other benefits such as 401k with company matching, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability and Life Insurance
* Growth Opportunities


C\&P specializes in the manufacture and distribution of a complete line of pipe hangers and supports for commercial and industrial applications since 1913\. With five locations in the U.S and growing., our supports have been specified and installed on major water treatment, pharmaceutical, process piping, petro\-chemical, hospitals, and school buildings as well as many other industrial projects throughout the world.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**



The Executive Assistant provides high\-level administrative and operational support to coDesign's executive team, acting as a trusted right hand who keeps leadership organized, informed, and focused on strategic priorities. This role requires sound judgment, discretion with sensitive information, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. The ideal candidate has several years of experience supporting senior executives, ideally within a fast\-paced, growing company.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


**1\.0 Executive Support**


* Manage complex, overlapping calendars for multiple executives, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritizing time against each executive's strategic goals — and against each other's competing demands.
* Serve as a central point of coordination across the executive team, flagging when priorities conflict and helping executives (or their delegate) make trade\-off decisions on time and attention.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for multiple executives, including itineraries, accommodations, and expense reconciliation.
* Prepare, proofread, and format correspondence, presentations, board materials, and internal communications on behalf of the executive team.
* Screen and prioritize incoming communications across executives, exercising discretion on what requires which executive's attention versus delegation.
* Act as a liaison between the executive team and internal teams, clients, and external partners, representing the executive team professionally at all times.
* Leverage AI tools to streamline drafting, scheduling, research, and follow\-up tasks, helping the executive team move faster without sacrificing quality or accuracy.


**2\.0 Meeting \& Project Coordination**


* Plan and coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including agenda development, materials preparation, and minute\-taking.
* Track action items from executive meetings and follow up to ensure timely completion.
* Support cross\-functional projects led by the executive team, helping keep initiatives on schedule and stakeholders aligned.
* Manage and maintain executive tasks and cross\-functional projects in ClickUp, ensuring action items, deadlines, and priorities stay visible and up to date.


**3\.0 Financial \& Administrative Support**


* Process executive expense reports and reconcile corporate card activity in line with company policy.
* Assist with budget tracking for executive\-led initiatives as needed.
* Maintain confidential files, contracts, and records with a high degree of accuracy and discretion.


**4\.0 People and Performance**


* Always comply with company policies and procedures and continually display company values.
* Actively participate in forums, training programs and education as directed by the company.
* Actively work towards achieving individual and business objectives.
* Continually work towards building and maintaining productive and sound working relationships with all internal and external stakeholders.


**5\.0 Office \& Operational Support**


* Partner with the broader operations team on office logistics, vendor coordination, and special projects as needed.
* Assist colleagues whenever there is an opportunity to do so.


**Qualifications and Experience**


* 5\+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C\-suite or senior leadership.
* Advanced Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 skills (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder calendars and travel logistics.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Comfortable adopting and using AI tools to increase efficiency in daily tasks.


**Person Specification**


* Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions independently on behalf of executives.
* Accuracy and attention to detail, even under time pressure.
* Sense of urgency, deadline driven with exceptional organizational and multi\-tasking skills.
* Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple executives without letting any one person's urgency crowd out the others.
* Motivated individual with the ability to work both independently and within a team.


**About coDesign**CoDesign is a workspace design and build start\-up looking for awesome talent who want to unleash their potential and grow in their career/ life. We offer our clients in the San Francisco / Bay Area a new, far better, and simpler way to a workspace. This role offers an excellent platform for expansion of responsibility and valuable insight into all projects; a young and energetic team to work with; and an exciting business model experiencing explosive growth! Our culture is built on collaboration and a passion for designing and building awesome workspaces.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

  


**Position Summary:**

  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Program Coordinator. In this role, the successful candidate is responsible for providing basic to moderate coordination for the Dermatopathology Unit of the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Dermatology. Works across clinical, laboratory, technical, research, and administrative functions and collaborates with internal and external parties to organize and coordinate the various components required to initiate, implement, and complete Unit programs, projects, and operational initiatives. Supports the coordination and optimization of laboratory workflows, specimen routing and logistics, scheduling, EMR integrations, equipment and facility needs, vendor relationships, and other operational processes. Coordinates activities associated with the expansion of laboratory services and the implementation of new capabilities, including the transition of currently outsourced testing to in\-house processing and support of the Units 24\-hour operational model.  

Promotes, coordinates, and supports the development and administration of research programs, including gathering, organizing, tracking, and performing basic analysis of data. Facilitates administrative processes related to recruitment and onboarding, maintenance of records, scheduling and coordination of meetings and programs, non\-traditional volunteer processing, visa processing, purchasing, and the organization of seminars, training programs, and other Unit activities. Supports workflow improvement and growth\-related initiatives and coordinates with physicians, laboratory staff, administrative teams, Information Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation and follow\-through. Reports to the Division Administrator and works collaboratively across all operational functions of the Dermatopathology Unit.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**

  


* **Operations \& Program Coordination** Coordinates daily operations, programs, projects, meetings, schedules, and initiatives across clinical, technical, laboratory, and administrative teams. Manages timelines, logistics, resources, communications, action items, and follow\-up with internal and external stakeholders to support successful implementation and ongoing operations.

jobs.title: CRM Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**  

Our roster has an opening with your name on it



FanDuel is seeking a detail\-oriented and enthusiastic **CRM Operations Coordinator** to join our CRM Operations team. In this role, you'll be responsible for building and executing CRM campaigns and customer journeys across email, push, and in\-app channels. You'll work closely with internal stakeholders to support a variety of marketing and business initiatives—ensuring timely, accurate, and high\-quality campaign delivery that drives customer engagement and business results.



This is a great opportunity for someone looking to start a career in marketing operations or CRM, and who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.



In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  


**THE GAME PLAN**  

Everyone on our team has a part to play


* Build and deploy omni\-channel CRM campaigns (email, push, in\-app) using our marketing automation platform(s)
* Support QA efforts to ensure campaigns are accurate, render properly across devices, aligned with channel best practices, and optimized to deliver a seamless, high\-quality customer experiences that meet the requirements of the campaign strategy
* Translate campaign briefs into well\-executed customer journeys using audience segmentation, personalization, and dynamic content
* Maintain campaign production timelines, QA checklists, and stakeholder communications to ensure flawless \& efficient execution
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Customer Marketing, Promotions, Creative, Commercial and other Operations functions to bring campaigns to life
* Develop deep expertise in our marketing technology systems, leveraging platform capabilities to optimize campaign execution and drive improved customer engagement performance
* Execute A/B tests and personalization strategies as directed by the Strategy teams
* Assist with copywriting and content adaptation for CRM campaigns, ensuring messaging is clear, on\-brand, and tailored to specific customer segments and channels.
* Proactively identify and escalate any campaign blockers, risks, or technical issues
* Document and help optimize operational processes and best practices for repeatable, accurate execution

  


**THE STATS**  

What we're looking for in our next teammate


* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* Meticulous attention to detail, outstanding organizational \& communication skills, project management skills, and ability to multi\-task and prioritize
* Experience managing marketing campaign execution, timelines, and deployment within a fast\-paced, complex business environment
* Excellent team player with strong collaborative skills and the ability to work cross\-functionally, a self\-starter and a quick learner
* Knowledge and experience of data and marketing functionality of at least one email service provider (experience with Braze and Movable Ink strongly preferred)
* Basic understanding of Marketing communications engagement metrics
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to troubleshoot and make minor edits to CRM templates for accurate rendering across devices and email clients. More advanced knowledge, a plus.
* Strong copywriting skills with the ability to craft concise, engaging, and customer\-centric messaging across email, push, and in\-app channels
* Comfortable with querying and logic (SQL knowledge a plus)
* Knowledge of Photoshop preferred
* Basic analytics skills using data to tackle problems
* Willing to work non\-traditional hours, including weekends and evening shifts
* Has a positive attitude and loves opportunities to collaborate with others
* An avid sports and gaming fan, and have played FanDuel or competitive products

  


**ABOUT FANDUEL**



FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.



In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.



The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.



FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).


**PLAYER BENEFITS**  

We treat our team right



We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level.



FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender ident

jobs.title: Merchandise Coordinator - Licensed Products - Flag & Anthem
jobs.description:
**Merchandising Coordinator – Licensed Products**

**Flag \& Anthem**

Position Summary

Flag \& Anthem is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Merchandising Coordinator – Licensed Products** to support the execution of our growing Licensed Products business across **Collegiate, Golf, NASCAR, Corporate, and other strategic licensing partnerships.**

This role is responsible for coordinating product samples, supporting merchandising initiatives, developing sales tools, managing reporting, and ensuring seamless communication across internal teams and external partners. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys managing multiple priorities, and plays a key role in bringing seasonal product assortments to market.

Primary Responsibilities

1\. Sample Management

Own and manage all licensed product samples throughout the product lifecycle across Collegiate, Golf, NASCAR, Corporate, and other licensed categories. Coordinate sample requests for internal meetings, sales appointments, customer presentations, marketing initiatives, ecommerce photography, and executive reviews while maintaining an organized sample library and accurate inventory of all samples.

2\. Ambassador \& Athlete Product Coordination

Coordinate product requests for professional golfers, brand ambassadors, corporate partners, and sponsored athletes. Manage seasonal product allocations, shipment logistics, and special requests to ensure product is delivered accurately and on time for tournaments, appearances, marketing initiatives, and special events.

3\. Merchandising Coordination

Support the execution of seasonal licensed assortments by maintaining merchandising whiteboards, managing assortment updates, coordinating special product requests, and assisting with line planning across Collegiate, Golf, NASCAR, and Corporate businesses. Ensure merchandising tools remain current throughout the product development process.

4\. Line Sheet \& Sales Material Development

Create and maintain seasonal line sheets, customer presentations, and sales support materials for Golf, Collegiate, NASCAR, Corporate, and licensed collections. Ensure product information, pricing, imagery, and assortment details are accurate and current for customer presentations and national sales meetings.

5\. Sales Support

Partner with the Sales organization to prepare seasonal sample assortments, showroom presentations, and customer\-specific product requests. Coordinate product for market appointments and ensure sales teams have the tools and samples needed to effectively present each collection.

6\. Inventory Management \& Business Reporting

Manage sample inventory while supporting weekly ATS, inventory, and business reporting. Maintain reporting dashboards, monitor inventory trends, and distribute weekly reporting that supports merchandising decisions and business planning.

7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

Serve as a key liaison between Merchandising, Product Development, Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce, Production, Distribution, and Customer Service to ensure projects remain on schedule, priorities are communicated, and seasonal product launches are executed successfully.

Success in This Role

The successful candidate will consistently deliver organized sample management, maintain accurate merchandising tools and reporting, support high\-impact sales initiatives, and ensure seamless coordination across departments to drive the continued growth of Flag \& Anthem's Licensed Products business.

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Come for the job, thrive in your career, and enjoy the journey of Making the Stay.

The coordinator role is responsible for assisting with the execution of strategic marketing plans and providing tactical marketing support for the New York City managed cluster. This role is slated to be in\-person and will sit at Waldorf Astoria New York.  



  

**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Area **Marketing Coordinator NYC / NJ** , you’re not just supporting department initiatives and office management – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


**Content \& Asset Management:** Assists in managing, executing, and regular audits of marketing\-specific assets, collateral, website, 3rd party sites, social media, digital \& traditional advertising and coordinating photo / video shoots.


**On\-Property Experiences:** Assists the Area Director of Marketing with identification and tactical elements of the hotel’s programming, activations, and partnerships.


**Digital Marketing:** Assist with the creation and execution of all digital media in alignment with digital marketing calendar planning.

**Public Relations Support:** Assists with the coordination of media visits, including itinerary confirmations, property tours, distribution of media kits, etc.


**Additional Tactical Support:** provides as\-needed tactical and project\-based marketing support in order to effectively and efficiently execute the hotel’s strategic marketing plans.


**Administrative Support:** Works with marketing team to prioritize key activities of wider strategic projects and tasks. Assists with processing invoices for marketing initiatives.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring an **Event Marketing Manager** to own a segment for event marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.
* Work ethic that matches our pace – sleeves rolled up, high throughput, and clear prioritization.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

  


**Position Summary:**

  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator. The Department of Pediatrics, Division of Pediatric Endocrinology \& Diabetes is seeking a Research Coordinator to support diverse portfolio of clinical research studies and trials. This role is responsible for coordinating day\-to\-day study activities, including recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, data collection, study visits, and regulatory support. The Research Coordinator works closely with investigators, research staff, patients, and families, and serves as a liaison with the IRB, sponsors, and funding agencies. The ideal candidate will help ensure research is conducted efficiently and in compliance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice, HIPAA, and institutional requirements.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* Recruitment and Enrollment \- Apply knowledge of study inclusion and exclusion criteria to identify and screen potential participants. Support recruitment and enrollment goals through outreach, collaboration with providers and internal teams, chart review, and community engagement. Discuss study opportunities with patients and families, obtain informed consent, schedule initial visits, and gather relevant information from medical records, referrals, and other recruitment sources. Review screening and enrollment documentation with the Principal Investigator, including eligibility, consent, and participant willingness to enroll.
* Research Activities \- Collects patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Uses tools to facilitate data collection (e.g. calendars, schedules, tracking logs, etc). Audits and updates the database or the case report forms. Prepares for and conducts study visits, obtains and documents information within the time frame specified.
* Study Regulations \- Aware of study regulatory status and helps keep an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Performs ongoing informed consent and follows through regularly with the patient/subjects and reminds them of visits and compliance. If applicable, updates and submits necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research. Secures accurate signatures and forwards documents and/or forms to appropriate destination. Might prepare and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials and provide other information in timely manner, as necessary.
* Clinical Competency \- Position may require competency in clinical responsibilities as per protocol such as vitals and/or weight and height, phlebotomy technique, centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Other trainings and competencies may be included as required.
* Continuous Learning \- Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development. It is expected that the employee demonstrates proof of ongoing research education and learning. Training programs are provided through the NYU and the office of science and research.
* Reporting and Analysis \- Gathers and compiles data and assists in preparing data for presentation to sponsoring and regulatory agencies. Provides reports to all necessary parties (e.g., the principal investigator, sponsoring agency, etc.) on the progress of the study as needed. Conduct primary analysis to data collected. Formulates, prepares database and generates preliminary measurement reports for review.
* Submissions \- Assists in the preparation of research applications and related activities such as grant submissions, study site initiation or study site visits. Collects and organizes required paperwork if required. Follows up and coordinates resolution of all issues to the sponsors.
* Participates in special projects, quality improvement efforts and performs other duties as required.

  




**Additional Position Specific Responsibilities:**

  

May require local travel to other NYU Langone campuses.

  


**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

To qualify you must have a Bachelor's degree in life sciences, allied health or equivalent in a related discipline and 0\-1 years experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Effective oral, written, communication, interpersonal skills. Must be able to work under the direction of supervision. Ability to operate research related equipment. Proficiency in using various Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, Access, Power Point and Outlook. Familiar with Internet applications. Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems. jobs.title: Account Manager, Mid-Market Standalone (Growth)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Standalone Account Managers are ambitious AM’s who can manage a more strategic sales cycle while being an advisor to customers that are consolidating more of their tech stack to Rippling.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Assist customers who are only using Rippling for specific product suites realize the full potential of the platform by consolidating more of their processes into Rippling.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* You will field customer requests and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions\-based selling approach.
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings.
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross\-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets.
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting.
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager to devise account plans, long\-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross\-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long\-term.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 3\+ years of SaaS experience in account management or sales.
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant).
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done.
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process.
* Proven success building and maintaining long\-term commercial relationships.
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company.
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented; great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about a great company for the long term.
* New Logo Sales / Account Executive experience a plus, but not required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive compensation package including benefits \+ equity.


A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

  

Compensation for this role \- OTE (60/40 commission split for base/variable pay)


Tier 1: $170,000 /year OTE (Office based)

* **Commission is not guaranteed**

jobs.title: Account Manager (Advertiser Success)
jobs.description:
Adflow is Fluent's commerce media advertising platform, connecting top\-tier brands with highly engaged consumers through proprietary ad inventory, first\-party data, and machine learning\-driven optimization. We're seeking an Account Manager to join our growing Advertiser Success team. In this role, you will use your performance marketing expertise, analytical, communication, and relationship\-building skills to provide superior client service, research, and market analysis for the advertisers on the Adflow platform. You will persistently explore and uncover the business needs of your clients, managing a book of business while developing comprehensive strategies that drive revenue growth and long\-term partnership success. If you're a self\-motivated and results\-driven person who thrives in a fast\-paced ad tech environment and knows how to turn data into client wins, this is the role where you'll thrive.

**What You'll Do:**

* Rapidly gain a thorough understanding of Adflow's proprietary ad inventory, machine learning\-driven optimization, reporting analysis, competitive advantages, resources, and processes, and articulate them persuasively to new and existing advertisers
* Manage a book of business and maintain strong relationships with new and existing advertisers on the Adflow platform, to successfully meet and exceed client performance expectations and ensure long\-term success
* Monitor client budgets, with a focus on growing advertising spend on Adflow inventory; prepare and present formal business reviews to top clients
* Serve as lead for all client communication, including onboarding, performance feedback, creative changes, pacing reports, performance reports, client meetings, campaign recommendations, and comprehensive strategy to enable revenue growth
* In partnership with Advertiser Success leadership, identify, create, and implement solutions grounded in measurable business results; serve as an external product consultant educating advertisers and agencies on Adflow's ad solutions and best practices, and grow the partnership
* Understand each client's key performance indicators, and clearly communicate these metrics internally for optimization
* Proactively introduce new revenue\-driving opportunities across Adflow's inventory and channels
* Manage the onboarding process for new advertisers, coordinating the flow of campaign builds with Business Development and Partner Development, creative execution with the Creative Strategy team, and tracking requirements with the Media Operations team
* Work closely with the Campaign Strategy, Media Operations, and Creative Strategy teams to provide continued feedback and analysis, optimization suggestions, and recommendations
* Formulate plans to extend new business and additional channel distribution with established accounts
* Responsible for overseeing monthly billable numbers to finance for invoicing

  

**Requirements**  

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience managing a book of business within digital performance marketing or ad tech; commerce media experience a plus
* Extremely organized and meticulous, as you will manage many advertiser campaigns simultaneously
* Exceptional communicator, comfortable presenting to advertiser and internal stakeholders
* Attentive to client budgets and spend targets, conscientious of revenue pacing, and experienced in exercising sales skills
* Excellent analytical skills
* High proficiency in Excel
* Excellent written communication skills
* Self\-motivated, self\-starter mentality

**About Us**


Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNT) is a commerce media solutions provider connecting top\-tier brands with highly engaged consumers. Leveraging diverse ad inventory, robust first\-party data, and proprietary machine learning, Fluent unlocks additional revenue streams for partners and empowers advertisers to acquire their most valuable customers at scale. Founded in 2010, Fluent uses its deep expertise in performance marketing to drive monetization and increase engagement at key touchpoints across the customer journey. For more insights visit: https://www.fluentco.com/

 **Benefits**  

Benefits


At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight\-knit crew of go\-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity\-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza\-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too…

* Competitive compensation
* Ample career and professional growth opportunities
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre\-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs
* 401K with competitive employer match
* Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year
* Educational and social events
* The amazing opportunity to work for a high\-flying performance marketing company!
