* Manage the visitor and employee office experience, including reception coverage, badges, office communications, and day\-to\-day troubleshooting.
* Support office\-related events, team meetings, executive visits, and cross\-functional gatherings with a high level of customer service and follow\-through.
***Project Management, Systems \& Light Accounting Support***

* Support strategic\- and Finance\-related projects by tracking timelines, deliverables, meeting notes, owners, and follow\-up items to ensure progress and accountability.
* Assist with coordination of Finance processes and recurring activities, including audit requests, budget meetings, procurement workflows, and departmental communications.
* Provide light system support, including maintaining distribution lists, access request tracking, SharePoint/OneDrive organization, workflow status logs, running reports, and basic user coordination with IT or system owners.
* Provide accounting and administrative support, such as invoice routing, coding support, purchase order follow\-up, vendor setup coordination, expense documentation, and reconciliation assistance under Finance guidance.
***Records \& Systems***

* Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for Finance and office records, including appropriate naming conventions, version control, and retention practices.
* Support maintenance of confidential Finance, executive, vendor, contract, audit, tax, insurance, and administrative records in accordance with company policies.
***Additional Responsibilities***

* Identify opportunities to streamline administrative workflows, improve Finance team coordination, enhance office efficiency, and strengthen records organization.
* Act like an owner with a sense of urgency, escalating issues appropriately and following through until completion.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Minimum of 8 years of experience in a corporate environment as an executive assistant, administrative professional, office manager, or similar role; experience supporting senior executives preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, professional presence, sound judgment, and strong customer\-service orientation.
* High degree of discretion and ability to handle confidential, sensitive, and time\-critical information appropriately.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and comfort learning company systems and workflows.
* Experience supporting a CFO, Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Legal, or other corporate executive function.
* Project coordination experience, including tracking action items, timelines, deliverables, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Familiarity with basic accounting administration, invoice processing, purchase orders, expense reporting, vendor coordination, or ERP/workflow systems.
* Experience supporting facilities, vendors, office operations, and onsite executive or team events.
**Core Competencies**

* Executive Presence \& Judgment — represents the CFO and Finance team professionally and handles sensitive matters with discretion.

* Communication Excellence — prepares clear, concise, accurate, and audience\-appropriate communications and materials.

jobs.title: Patient Experience and Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
Part\-Time \| Chicago, IL \| 9–18 Hours/Week

Compensation at the bottom of description.

About Framed

Framed Eyewear is an independent optical business focused on providing a highly personalized, luxury patient experience. We are a small, growing company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, education, and genuine relationships over the traditional high\-volume retail environment.

We're looking for a Patient Experience \& Outreach Coordinator to become an important part of our growing Chicago team.

This is a people\-focused position for someone who enjoys making people feel welcome, building relationships, creating opportunities, and representing a business they genuinely believe in.

The role combines patient experience, appointment generation, community outreach, light styling, and day\-to\-day showroom support.

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including opticians, optical technicians, retail professionals, hospitality professionals, and people with strong customer\-service and relationship\-building experience.

What You'll Do

Patient Experience

Patient experience comes first whenever a patient or visitor is in the showroom.

* Welcome every patient and visitor in a warm, professional, and genuine manner
* Serve as the first point of contact for walk\-ins, phone calls, messages, and inquiries
* Help create a polished, elevated, and personalized showroom experience
* Assist with light frame styling when appropriate
* Anticipate patient needs and look for opportunities to make their experience easier, more comfortable, and more personalized

Scheduling \& Patient Follow\-Up

* Schedule appointments for new and prospective patients
* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, messages, and other patient inquiries
* Follow up with prospective patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled
* Confirm upcoming appointments and assist with rescheduling when needed
* Track inquiries and follow\-up so that prospective patients don't fall through the cracks
* Follow up with patients as appropriate before and after appointments

Community Outreach \& Business Development

* Identify businesses and organizations that may be a natural fit for Framed's patient base
* Initiate conversations with prospective community partners and look for mutually beneficial opportunities and follow up
* Identify opportunities to generate new patients through local outreach and relationship\-building
* Participate in local events and community activities when appropriate

Showroom \& Administrative Support

* Keep the showroom clean, organized, polished, and presentation\-ready throughout the day
* Restock basic supplies and showroom materials as needed
* Receive, organize, and put away deliveries when needed

Who We’re Looking For

Optical experience is welcome but not required. Opticians and optical technicians, particularly those earlier in their careers, are encouraged to apply.

* Naturally personable and comfortable talking with people they don't know
* Understands and embraces the expectations of a luxury, high\-touch environment
* Polished, professional, warm, and dependable
* Attentive to detail and understands that small details can make a significant difference
* Confident approaching local businesses and starting conversations
* Comfortable working independently
* Curious and eager to learn
* Good at reading people and understanding what they need
* Interested in eyewear, fashion, design, hospitality, or exceptional customer experience
* Comfortable with sales and asking for the appointment, but never pushy
* Someone who wants to be part of building something rather than simply clocking in and out

Our Philosophy

At Framed, we believe luxury is about the experience, not simply the product.

We don't believe in pressure, gimmicks, or treating people like transactions. The best business growth comes from earning people's trust, not pressuring them into a purchase.

Our goal is for every person who walks through our door to feel that their time, their needs, and their experience genuinely matter.

A Career, Not Just a Job

We believe there should be no ceiling on what you can become at Framed.

As Framed grows, this role may expand in hours and responsibility, with opportunities to develop additional optical, patient\-experience, business\-development, and leadership skills. For the right candidate, this part\-time position has the potential to develop into a full\-time salaried position with significantly greater responsibility and earning potential.

Schedule \& Compensation

* Part\-time: 9–18 hours per week
* Guaranteed schedule: 9 hours/week \- Tuesday \& Thursday, 1:30–6:00 PM
* Additional hours: Up to 9 additional hours/week \- Monday \& Friday, 1:30–6:00 PM, based on availability and business needs.
* Occasional additional fill\-in opportunities may be available as the business grows and other team members schedules require
* Starting pay: $18/hour
* Commission pay: Compensation is a guaranteed base wage of $18\.00/hour plus performance\-based commission. With commissions factored in, our average team members earn between $24 and $30/hour, while top performers earn up to $38/hour.
* Additional performance\-based compensation
* Paid leave and sick leave provided in accordance with applicable law
* Opportunities for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as the company grows

Pay: From $18\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 9\.0 – 18\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.


We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


We’re looking for a self\-driven, growth\-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid\-remote US\-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back\-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one our fastest growing customer segments.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions\-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in\-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross\-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross\-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long\-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota\-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented; great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.title: Client Success Executive
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately\-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big\-hearted, tech\-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.



We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

  

The Client Success Executive (CSE) is responsible for ensuring clients achieve maximum value from the company's products or services, fostering long\-term client satisfaction, and driving client retention and growth. The CSE works closely with clients to understand their goals, ensure effective adoption, and identify opportunities for account expansion and business growth. This role involves day\-to\-day client management, proactive engagement to address client needs, and collaborating cross\-functionally to drive success outcomes.



The ideal candidate will have a background in mid\-scale customer relationship management with demonstrated success exceeding expectations maintaining and growing their book.



What you’ll do


* Client Value Realization: Work closely with clients to understand their business objectives and ensure the company’s product or service delivers measurable value aligned with their goals.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, managing day\-to\-day communications and ensuring strong relationships with client stakeholders at all levels.
* Onboarding \& Adoption: Lead clients through the onboarding process and drive product/service adoption by providing training, best practices, and ongoing support tailored to their specific needs.
* Client Growth \& Upselling: Identify opportunities for account growth, including upselling additional services, cross\-selling complementary products, and recommending new solutions that enhance client success and increase revenue.
* Retention \& Renewal Management: Proactively manage client renewals, minimizing churn through ongoing engagement and demonstrating continuous value.
* Client Health Monitoring: Regularly track and assess client health, using data and insights to identify risks and opportunities for deeper engagement and growth.
* Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute client success plans that align with client goals and foster long\-term partnerships, driving retention and growth within assigned accounts.
* Performance Metrics \& Reporting: Monitor key success metrics such as adoption rates, client satisfaction scores (NPS/CSAT), and revenue growth. Regularly report progress and outcomes to both clients and internal stakeholders.
* Issue Resolution: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring any issues or concerns are addressed swiftly and effectively, coordinating with internal teams as necessary.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure a seamless client experience and identify opportunities for improvement or innovation in the client journey.
* Client Feedback \& Product Improvement: Collect and relay client feedback to internal teams, providing insights to improve product offerings, services, and overall client experience.
* Other duties as assigned


What you’ll bring


* Education: Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience.
* Experience: 5 \- 7\+ years' related industry experience in consulting, sales, or other applicable area.
* Proven experience in client success, account management, or customer experience, with a focus on driving client outcomes and revenue growth.
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills, capable of working with a variety of client stakeholders, including executives.
* Experience in managing complex client accounts and coordinating across multiple departments.
* A results\-driven mindset, with a focus on client retention, growth, and overall satisfaction.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and client success platforms.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills to proactively address client challenges.
* Travel required as needed – cyclical depending on client needs.
* Protect and take care of our company and member’s data every day by committing to work within our company ethics and policies.


**What’s in it for you:**


* **Compensation:** Competitive base and incentive compensation
* **Coverage:** Health, vision and dental featuring our best\-in\-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
* **Balance:** Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
* **Development:** Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
* **Culture:** Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15\+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people\-first values that drive every decision.
* **Environment:** A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full\-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry\-cleaning services and more!

* **Internal Associates:** Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever

new_jobs.description:
**Outlandish Inc.** is a fast\-growing social commerce company and TikTok Shop Partner Agency helping brands, creators, and businesses grow through TikTok Shop, livestreaming, creator partnerships, content, and e\-commerce strategy.

We operate in a fast\-paced, highly creative environment where social media is at the center of what we do. We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager** who understands internet culture, knows what makes content perform, and can help build and grow the Outlandish brand across social platforms.

**About the Role:**

As our **Social Media Manager**, you will own and help execute Outlandish's day\-to\-day social media presence. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can think strategically while also jumping in to create, film, edit, post, and analyze content.

You should have a strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, be comfortable identifying trends and turning ideas into engaging content quickly, and understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance.

We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow trends, you understand why content works and can use performance data, audience behavior, and creative testing to continuously improve our social presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute Outlandish's overall social media strategy across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Own and maintain the social media content calendar, including planning, scheduling, publishing, and coordinating content.
* Create engaging short\-form content from concept through execution, including filming, editing, writing captions, and publishing.
* Develop creative concepts, hooks, scripts, recurring content series, and social campaigns that align with the Outlandish brand.
* Stay highly informed on TikTok, Instagram, creator economy, e\-commerce, social commerce, and internet trends.
* Identify relevant trends and quickly determine how they can be adapted authentically for the Outlandish brand.
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content from our team, offices, livestream studios, creators, events, and company initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify stories, projects, events, milestones, and educational opportunities that can become social content.
* Manage community engagement, including comments, messages, mentions, and opportunities to interact with our audience.
* Monitor social media performance and track KPIs including reach, views, engagement, follower growth, watch time, click\-through rates, and other relevant metrics.
* Use performance data to identify what is and isn't working and make recommendations for future content.
* Continuously test different hooks, formats, posting strategies, creative concepts, and content styles.
* Help strengthen and maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across platforms.
* Monitor competitors and industry leaders to identify emerging trends, content opportunities, and best practices.
* Support social coverage for company events, creator activations, livestreams, and other special projects as needed.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram, including platform culture, trends, algorithms, and content best practices.
* Hands\-on experience creating short\-form video content for TikTok, Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
* Comfortable filming content using a phone or camera and editing short\-form videos.
* Experience with editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar platforms.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and what keeps viewers watching.
* Ability to write engaging, platform\-appropriate captions and social copy.
* Experience managing a content calendar and maintaining a consistent publishing schedule.
* Comfortable reviewing analytics and translating performance data into actionable content decisions.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and adapt when trends or business priorities change.
* Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple departments.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working with creators, influencers, or UGC content.
* Experience growing a brand's social media presence organically.
* Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools.
* Photography, videography, graphic design, or advanced video\-editing experience.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency, startup, creator, entertainment, or social\-first environment.

**What Success Looks Like:**

Success in this role means consistently creating content that strengthens the Outlandish brand, grows our audience, increases engagement, and keeps our social presence relevant within the rapidly changing world of social commerce.

You’ll be expected to bring ideas to the table, take ownership of execution, pay attention to performance, and continuously look for ways to make our content better.

**Why Join Outlandish?**

At Outlandish, you'll be working directly within the rapidly evolving world of TikTok Shop, creators, livestreaming, and social commerce. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with new ideas, create content around an exciting and growing industry, and play an important role in shaping how the Outlandish brand shows up online.

**If you're creative, social\-first, data\-aware, and always thinking about the next piece of content, we'd love to hear from you!**

Chapman University is a nationally ranked, R2 Carnegie Classified, private institution offering traditional undergraduate and graduate programs in the heart of Orange County, one of Southern California’s most diverse and vibrant regions. The curriculum combines theory with applied industry\-focused learning, strategy, research, creativity, campaign development, digital and social media, and presenting. For this program, we represent the owner’s technology organization, translating AI infrastructure requirements into facility specifications and verifying that construction meets those requirements.


**Learn more:** https://www.skaxusa.com/

 **Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator \- Document Control** to oversee project documentation and support on\-site coordination for a large\-scale AI data center construction program in San Jose, California.


As one of three full\-time resident staff members, you will own the document control function and coordinate the flow of information among the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator. The program spans four construction phases through Q3 2028\.


Your responsibilities will include revision control, submittal tracking, meeting coordination, inspection and commissioning records, permitting documentation, and project turnover. You will ensure project information remains accurate, current, traceable, and accessible throughout the program.


This role requires hands\-on ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across organizations while working closely with project leadership and technical teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Document Control \& Configuration Management**

* Maintain version and revision control for drawings, specifications, technical requirements, and interface control documents.
* Manage document issuance and distribution, track approval status, and ensure teams can clearly identify the current revision.
* Publish and maintain the configuration register weekly.
* Issue revision notices to affected stakeholders and maintain a traceable record of document changes.

 **Multi\-Party Submittal Coordination**

* Receive, register, and distribute deliverables from the general contractor, construction owner’s representative, technology partner, and systems integrator.
* Maintain a daily submittal intake register and monitor outstanding or overdue deliverables.
* Follow up with responsible parties and escalate delays before they affect project milestones.
* Flag inconsistencies between organizations’ documents for review by the technical team.

 **Meeting Coordination \& Action Tracking**

* Coordinate approximately 10–15 recurring and ad hoc meetings per month, including contractor coordination meetings, owner reviews, and phase gate sessions.
* Prepare and distribute agendas and pre\-read materials.
* Produce and distribute meeting minutes within two business days.
* Maintain action item registers, including responsible owners, due dates, and closure evidence.
* Follow up on open actions and escalate overdue items to project leadership.

 **Inspection \& Commissioning Records**

* Document factory testing, site testing, and integrated system testing activities, including attendance, observations, photographs, and test reports.
* Maintain non\-conformance report (NCR) and punch list registers through closure.
* Assemble evidence packages supporting the owner’s technical acceptance assessments at each phase gate.
* Coordinate with engineering and field teams to maintain complete, traceable inspection and commissioning records.

 **Permitting Documentation**

* Compile and track permit submittal packages.
* Log comments, correction requests, and outstanding conditions from permitting authorities.
* Maintain approval histories and communicate documentation status to the project team.

 **As\-Built Documentation \& Project Turnover**

* Receive and catalog as\-built drawings and operations and maintenance (O\&M) documentation.
* Track documentation completeness and follow up on missing or incomplete submissions.
* Maintain the turnover deficiency list through project closeout.
* Organize final documentation packages for handover to the owner.

*Technical review and acceptance of as\-built documents remain the responsibility of the engineering team. This position manages document receipt, cataloging, and completeness tracking.*

 **Qualifications**

 **Required Experience**

* Three or more years of document control experience on construction or data center projects.
* Hands\-on experience with an electronic document management system such as Procore, Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or an equivalent platform.
* Demonstrated experience preparing meeting minutes and tracking action items in a technical environment.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are \& Why This Role Matters:**

Copia Resources CA, Inc. isn’t just another company. We are building an empire in the environmental services industry. If you’re looking for a cushy 9\-to\-5 where you can coast, this isn’t for you. We move fast, we solve problems, and we don’t settle for “good enough.”

We’re looking for an Operations Coordinator who will serve as the day\-to\-day owner of the client experience. From the moment a request or concern is received through final resolution, this person will coordinate the necessary internal action, communicate proactively with the client, document all commitments, and confirm that every issue has been fully resolved. You’ll be the connection between our clients, Customer Service team, field teams, and internal departments, ensuring everyone stays aligned, informed, and accountable.

If you’re proactive, solution\-oriented, and focused on delivering an exceptional client experience, this position is a perfect fit.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Customer Service Operations \& Client Support**

* Take ownership of client requests, concerns, and service issues from initial contact through final resolution, ensuring nothing is delayed, overlooked, or left incomplete.
* Coordinate the necessary action across Customer Service, Field Operations, Sales, Accounting, BPO representatives, haulers, vendors, and other internal or external partners.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for clients by setting clear expectations and providing proactive updates throughout the resolution process.
* Track commitments, deadlines, responsible parties, and next steps to ensure all internal and external follow\-up is completed accurately and on time.
* Confirm that the requested work has been completed, verify that the client’s concern has been addressed, and close the communication loop with everyone involved.
* Document client communications, decisions, commitments, and resolutions accurately in Salesforce.
* Identify unresolved issues, service failures, communication gaps, and at\-risk client relationships and escalate them promptly to the Customer Service Manager.
* Support client onboarding, service changes, and other client\-facing activities by coordinating requirements across departments.

**Customer Service Team Support \& Performance Monitoring**

* Serve as the primary support resource for BPO customer service representatives by providing guidance on processes, customer inquiries, escalation handling, and operational challenges.
* Help maintain consistency across the customer service team by supporting training, reviewing workflows, and identifying opportunities to improve team performance.
* Review customer interactions and Salesforce cases to ensure quality, accuracy, documentation, and adherence to company standards.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including response times, case quality, communication standards, and overall team effectiveness.
* Provide performance insights, trends, and recommendations to the Operations Manager during regular check\-ins.
* Support training initiatives, process updates, and continuous improvement efforts within the customer service team.

**Field Operations Support \& Communication**

* Maintain consistent communication with Route Supervisors, Area Managers, and field teams to support daily operational needs.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for field\-related questions, service challenges, scheduling concerns, and communication needs.
* Coordinate communication between Customer Service and Field Operations to ensure timely issue resolution and operational alignment.
* Identify recurring field\-related challenges and partner with Operations leadership to develop solutions that improve service consistency.
* Escalate significant operational concerns, safety issues, service risks, and recurring challenges to the Operations Manager.
* Support efforts to improve communication, collaboration, and information sharing between office teams and field operations.
* Location: San Ramon, CA (This is NOT a remote position).
* Work Schedule: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced environment requiring strong organization, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, field teams, and internal departments.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and confidence.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable taking ownership of issues and driving them through resolution.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting remote teams, BPO teams, or customer service teams preferred.
* Environmental services, waste, logistics, transportation, or field operations experience preferred.
* Travel Requirement: Regular local and regional travel to client sites and company locations is required, with occasional out\-of\-state or international travel as needed.
* Must have a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the ability to travel as required.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Compensation: $75,000 per year.
* 401(k) with company match
* Medical, dental, vision insurance
* Paid time off

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* You’ll lead a high\-performing team that’s redefining service excellence in the waste management industry.
* You’ll be challenged daily — to think bigger, move faster, and make things better.
* You’ll be part of a company that’s growing rapidly, creating room for you to grow your career with us.
* You’ll have real impact — every process you improve and every person you develop contributes directly to our success.

Pay: $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager and Community Outreach Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Asociación Mayab:**

Asociación Mayab is a non\-profit organization committed to the growth and well\-being of the Yucatec community in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Headquartered in San Francisco, we provide critical social services and emergency support to Maya immigrant families. In addition to our social services, we work diligently to preserve and promote Yucatec Maya culture and serve as a bridge between our community, local authorities, consulates, and the Mexican Yucatecan governments. Our mission is to foster community participation, encourage cultural exchange, and support economic development for Yucatecan immigrants in the Bay Area and their home communities. Through our programs and initiatives, we aim to strengthen the Yucatec Maya cultural values and promote access to essential services for our community members.

**Job Overview**

Asociación Mayab is seeking an experienced, university\-educated professional to provide high\-quality case management services and build strong relationships with community organizations, universities, government agencies and service providers. The ideal candidate must communicate clearly, confidently and naturally in professional English and Spanish. Excellent writing skills are required for formal letters, case notes, reports, referrals, emails and other official communications.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Education, Teaching, Sociology or a related field.
* Teachers with a bachelor's degree and other university\-educated professionals are encouraged to apply.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience working with families, students, community members,
* social\-service programs or case\-management services.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English and Spanish.
* Ability to write clear and professional letters, reports, case notes, referrals, emails and official communications.
* Strong public\-speaking, outreach and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, electronic databases and case\-management systems.
* Excellent organization, confidentiality, professional judgment and follow\-through.
* Three verifiable professional references.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Interview participants and assess individual and family needs.
* Develop individualized service and follow\-up plans.
* Connect participants with health, mental\-health, housing, legal, educational, employment and social\-service resources.
* Prepare professional case notes, formal letters, referrals, reports and correspondence.
* Maintain complete, accurate and confidential physical and electronic files.
* Follow each case through resolution, referral or appropriate closure.
* Communicate professionally with clients, attorneys, hospitals, agencies and service providers.
* Conduct outreach and represent Asociación Mayab at meetings, presentations and community events.
* Establish professional relationships with universities, nonprofit organizations, government agencies and community partners.
* Invite partner organizations to provide services and participate in Asociación Mayab programs and activities.
* Prepare regular reports and provide timely updates to the Executive Director.

We are seeking an ethical, compassionate, dependable and highly organized professional who can work independently and represent Asociación Mayab with confidence and professionalism.

**Application Materials**

* Current résumé
* Cover letter
* Confirmation of university degree
* Three professional references

Pay: $25\.45 \- $30\.65 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Education, Teaching, Sociology or a related field?
* Do you have at least five years of relevant professional experience working with families, students, community members, social\-service programs or case\-management services?
* Are you professionally fluent in spoken and written English and Spanish?
* Can you prepare professional letters, reports, case notes, referrals, emails and official communications?
* Do you have experience completing assessments, service plans, referrals and case follow\-up?
* Can you provide three verifiable professional references?

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**About Cogent**
----------------


Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. Since emerging from stealth, we’ve grown rapidly and partnered with global enterprises to secure some of the world’s most complex production environments.


Our product and talent are our biggest differentiators. Our team brings experience from:

* High growth technology companies including Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, and Coinbase.
* Leading cybersecurity companies including Wiz, Abnormal AI, and Zscaler.
* Preeminent machine learning research labs including DeepMind and SAIL.


Backed by Greylock and Bain Capital Ventures, we’re building a team that combines frontier AI research with deep cybersecurity expertise and the ability to execute at scale.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


Cogent is looking for a Channel Account Manager to build and grow our partner ecosystem across the Western US. You will own the regional channel strategy and be accountable for turning partner relationships into qualified pipeline and bookings.


This role is ideal for a cybersecurity channel leader who knows the Western partner ecosystem, is equally comfortable building strategy and working deals, and thrives in an early stage environment. This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and will cover the West, including Southern California, the Pacific Northwest, and Mountain/Southwest markets.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build and execute the Western US channel strategy, focusing investment on the partners most likely to produce revenue.
* Recruit, activate, and grow strategic resellers, advisory firms, service providers, and technology partners.
* Create joint account plans, map target accounts, and generate pipeline sourced or influenced by partners.
* Enable partners on Cogent’s value proposition and work alongside sales teams through registration, evaluation, and close.
* Track pipeline, bookings, partner productivity, and program ROI, using the data to refine the regional plan.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 7\+ years in channel, alliances, or partner development, including 5\+ years in cybersecurity.
* A strong network across the Western US cybersecurity partner ecosystem and a record of turning relationships into revenue.
* Experience building focused partner plans, enabling sellers, and selling complex enterprise security solutions alongside partners.
* Strong commercial judgment, operating discipline, and comfort owning pipeline and bookings targets.
* High growth or challenger company experience, with the willingness to travel and operate hands on.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, Mid-Market Standalone (Growth)
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Standalone Account Managers are ambitious AM’s who can manage a more strategic sales cycle while being an advisor to customers that are consolidating more of their tech stack to Rippling.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Assist customers who are only using Rippling for specific product suites realize the full potential of the platform by consolidating more of their processes into Rippling.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* You will field customer requests and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions\-based selling approach.
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings.
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross\-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets.
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting.
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager to devise account plans, long\-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross\-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long\-term.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 3\+ years of SaaS experience in account management or sales.
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant).
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done.
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process.
* Proven success building and maintaining long\-term commercial relationships.
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company.
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented; great follow\-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about a great company for the long term.
* New Logo Sales / Account Executive experience a plus, but not required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive compensation package including benefits \+ equity.


A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

  

Compensation for this role \- OTE (60/40 commission split for base/variable pay)


Tier 1: $170,000 /year OTE (Office based)

* **Commission is not guaranteed**

Molex is seeking an Account Manager who has experience working on server or switch system to support strategic leading enterprise customer in the data center market. On field support key customer to design win key project and grow business by professional application service.

* Support new parts qualification by the customers. Figure out different conditions behind the specs between customers and Molex. The goal is to pass the qualification
* Resolve complex mechanical application related technical problems to meet customer needs
* Support failure analysis, especially for new win projects. Collect all related factors on\-site, coordinate with the Quality and Development team, allocate all resources to solve the failure

* Ongoing development of personal expertise is critical to success in this role.
* Become an expert in understanding this customer's individual strategic business plans.

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent
* At least 5 years of related R\&D experience on Server or Switch product for a degree holder

* Experience of application on connector and cable assembly.
* Knowledge of server or switch hardware/architecture
* 3D mechanical design tool
* Agile, problem\-solving mind\-set
* A self\-driven and well\-organized person with a high initiative and the ability to work independently.

San Diego, California, United States of America  


**Extraordinary Care. Extraordinary Careers.**  


**With one of the nation’s largest, most innovative long\-term care pharmacy services providers, there is no limit to the growth of your career.**  


Ron's Pharmacy Services, a member of the Guardian family of pharmacies, has an exciting opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing team in San Diego, California.  


**Why Ron's Pharmacy Services? We’re reimagining medication management and transforming care.**  


**Who We Are and What We’re About:**  


Our core focus is delivering customized medication management solutions to support healthcare organizations serving seniors and individuals with complex care needs. With our comprehensive suite of tech\-enabled pharmacy services and a dedicated team of professionals committed to enriching the lives of those we serve, we are redefining how pharmacy care is delivered.  


We offer an opportunity to learn and grow your career in a fast\-paced, diverse, and inclusive environment. If you are looking for a challenging, team\-oriented environment in which you can put your expertise to work, then this is the place for you.  


**Part\-Time: 20 hours/week \| Potential to Grow to Full\-Time**  
**Compensation: $40–$46/hour**  
**Territory: East Bay / Northern California**  
**Travel Required \| Overnight Travel During Initial Training**  


**Be the trusted partner our Northern California facilities can count on.**  
Our pharmacy is expanding to service facilities in **Northern California**, and we're looking for an experienced, relationship\-driven **Account Manager** to serve as the local point of contact for our East Bay\-area customers.  


This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys **building relationships, solving problems, and making a real difference in the customer experience.**  


You'll work closely with facility leadership and staff, as well as our pharmacy operations team, to make sure our customers receive responsive service and the support they need. new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Liminal is the intelligence platform for the people building and buying the technology that keeps the digital economy safe. Our platform delivers AI\-powered solutions that empower customers to assess, interpret, and respond to global market shifts, critical events, and regulatory developments. We are a Series A company of about 60 people.

**The Role**
------------


Your job is to help our customers get the most out of verified, actionable intelligence tailored to their markets and problems. As a CSM, you own a portfolio of accounts and make sure each customer is using the platform to answer the questions that matter to their business, whether that's a game plan refresh, a battle card update, or a session with Coach AI.

  

That means understanding each customer's market, their workflows, and what they need to act on. When usage slows, you identify the cause and address it well ahead of the renewal. You will work with the Chief Operations Officer to build the core CS motions: the 90\-day onboarding program, health scoring, adoption milestones, and expansion triggers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own a portfolio of new and existing accounts as a trusted advisor and build durable, multi\-threaded relationships that grow across each customer's teams
* Lead the day\-to\-day relationship, coordinating across Liminal's advisory, research, product, and sales teams to bring the right people and the right intelligence to each customer
* Partner with customers to turn their market questions into real business outcomes, running game plan refreshes, battle card updates, and Coach AI sessions
* Demonstrate the platform's depth as customer needs evolve, surfacing use cases across our six markets they haven't yet tapped and connecting new capabilities to live problems on their desk
* Own credit consumption, adoption, and renewal health for a portfolio of accounts in the $50K–$200K range
* Run a 90\-day onboarding that takes new customers from platform access to confident, habitual use
* Monitor usage patterns and flag tier upgrade opportunities (Single Market to Multi\-Market) to the COO and Sales
* Watch for early churn signals such as slowing credit consumption, dormant users, and stalled workflows, and intervene with a clear plan
* Lead recurring business reviews that tie customer goals to platform outcomes and usage data
* Drive activation across multiple stakeholders in each account, not just the original champion
* Be the voice and champion for your customers internally, bringing their needs and issues to the Product team to improve value
* Keep account data current in HubSpot: health scores, usage signals, and expansion indicators
* Turn what works into playbooks, enablement, and repeatable CS motions the whole function can run

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3\+ years of professional experience in customer\-facing roles, including 2\+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS
* Maniacal commitment to customer experience: you sweat the details of every interaction and measure yourself by whether the customer actually succeeded, not whether the task got done
* Experience with usage\-based, consumption, or credit\-based commercial models
* Retention and expansion outcomes you can speak to specifically
* Comfort with data: you can read usage patterns, spot leading indicators of churn, and segment accounts by behavior
* Comfortability working with the latest AI models including connectors, MCP services, advanced configurations.
* Experience managing stakeholders from analysts to executives in enterprise accounts
* Familiarity with at least one of our six markets
* Experience at an early\-stage company where you helped build processes
* Able to work hybrid from our Union Square office

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* $95,000–$125,000 base salary plus performance bonus tied to NRR and consumption metrics, and equity
* The chance to help build the CS function and its playbooks
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k); flexible PTO
* Hybrid work based in Union Square, NYC

If this describes you, we encourage you to apply today.

  

The Project Coordinator II serves as a key operational and administrative anchor across the construction project lifecycle. This role manages contract administration, technical document control, project financials, and closeout workflows to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

*Contract Administration \& Procurement*

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Central & West Coast Regions
new_jobs.description:
**Building the people that build the world.**


With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world.


As part of Detection and Measurement, Genfare is a leader in configurable fare collection systems in the public transit industry. By creating high quality equipment and payment systems to improve the rider experience, we empower equitable mobility and provide services to better connect communities.

  


**JOB SUMMARY**

  


The Business Development Representative is a front\-line employee of Genfare and works to support the building, delivery and closing of pipeline of opportunities for revenue growth. The role is part sales (hardware and software), consultation (solutions), and account management.


The Business Development Representative is a critical sales generator for our company. This role is active in three main areas while working to meet or exceed a bookings’ quota:


1\. Obtain new business


2\. Expand sales received from existing customers; deepen and broaden relationships; and,


3\. Ensure retention of customers


The role works with small transit agencies (mostly those with 50 buses or fewer) and industry partners in a defined region, and proposes solutions relevant to their needs. Activity includes providing quotes and specifications, performing demos, and acting as the ultimate customer advocate. You are an individual contributor but can’t do everything on your own – you want to work with the larger team so you can understand the product and solutions to best sell to customers.


The role is very customer\-focused so be ready to visit, call, email and meet virtually with your transit agency counterparts. One of your main strengths is listening and building account plans to help map your customers’ goals into actions to meet their needs for today and plan for their future. You can translate those needs with our internal stakeholders to build viable, value\-driven solutions that solve real world problems that can be leveraged for multiple customers.


Reporting to the Regional Sales Director – Central \& West Regions, this role is critical for continued growth at Genfare with an established book of business and customer relationships.

 **PRINCIPLE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Contributes to the development and monitoring of the pipeline of sales activity for new business within a designated territory.
* Participates in the development and execution of short\- and long\-range sales plans.
* Responds to customer inquiries related to quote requests, escalations, RFPs, and future\-state needs.
* Supports the RFP and proposal development process by reviewing customer requirements, coordinating internal stakeholders, assisting with proposal content and pricing inputs, and participating in customer presentations and procurement discussions under the guidance of the Business Development Director.
* Works to identify and develop new customer relationships and further penetrate/expand existing customer relationships.
* Collaborates with company leadership to support the execution of the regional sales strategy.
* Visits existing and prospective customers to develop and/or expand client relationships.
* Gathers market intelligence to stay apprised of competitor offerings, pricing, distribution channels, market trends, etc.
* Participates in industry associations and conferences.
* Monitors performance of existing account relationships.
* Assists with special projects (as assigned by management) to support sales initiatives.

 **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

  

* Experience working with customers in a sales, account management, business development, and/or customer success role. Ability to develop trusted relationships and effectively communicate customer needs.
* Proven effectiveness in the use of professional sales methodologies and systems.
* An understanding of customer relationship management and cross\-selling techniques.
* Must be able to work effectively in a team environment and possess interpersonal skills necessary to successfully collaborate with others to achieve business goals.
* Ability to quickly analyze rapidly changing circumstances and to provide sound strategic and tactical sales advice.
* Ability to communicate and negotiate effectively, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to make effective presentations to diverse audiences – management and employees – both internally and externally.
* Adaptability and flexibility to manage multiple priorities and work under deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving skills with a methodical approach to problem resolution across large\-scale distributed platforms.
* Effectively build relationships and collaborate with stakeholders and partners.
* Demonstrates strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
* Familiarity with fare collection is desirable.

 **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

  

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s and/or advanced degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in progressive sales/business development with multiple services or product lines, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies and processing environments.

new_jobs.title: Account Developer, Inside Sales, Quill
new_jobs.description:
***This position is a minimum of 4 days in office with flexibility for remote work on Fridays.***

 **Join a team that powers everyday impact.**

  

Quill, a Staples company, is looking for a driven Inside Sales Site Development Representative to help grow relationships with existing and prospective customer locations connected to our managed account base. In this role, you will partner closely with account management, respond to customer needs, prepare negotiated quotes and special pricing, and make outbound calls that help reactivate customers, uncover new opportunities, and expand share of wallet. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys customer conversations, thrives in a goal\-oriented environment, and wants to build a strong foundation in business\-to\-business sales.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Make daily outbound calls to Quill customers who have not placed a recent order to support reactivation and revenue growth.
* Contact prospective customer locations affiliated with managed customer entities to identify needs and conversion opportunities.
* Accept inbound calls from customers tied to managed accounts and help ensure customer needs are met.
* Negotiate pricing and process special quotes for customer opportunities.
* Use customer insights, including order history, to guide quality conversations.
* Leverage specialized offers and Quill’s value proposition to help customers place orders and meet monthly quotas and key metrics.
* Maintain consistent communication with account managers to share customer trends and pricing solution opportunities.
* Partner with sales specialists and support teams to identify opportunities beyond traditional office supplies, including furniture, technology, high\-value quotes, print, and promotional products.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date activity, pipeline, and customer records in CRM.
* Apply coaching and feedback from managers and peers to continuously improve sales approach and performance.

 **What you bring to the table**

* Motivation to build customer relationships that create measurable value and growth.
* Clear, confident communication with customers and internal partners across calls, follow\-up, and solution\-focused conversations.
* Curiosity and strong listening skills to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and uncover opportunities.
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to connect customer needs to relevant products, programs, or solutions.
* Comfort making outbound calls, engaging customers, and continuing forward after rejection or setbacks.
* Strong organization, time management, and follow\-through when balancing customer conversations, priorities, and activity goals.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn quickly as customer needs, business priorities, or sales approaches change.
* A customer\-first approach focused on creating a positive, helpful, and professional experience in every interaction.
* Collaborative mindset with a willingness to share ideas, apply feedback, and learn from managers, peers, and business partners.
* Composure and critical thinking when prioritizing next steps, solving customer challenges, and supporting sales goals.

 **What’s needed\- Basic Qualifications**

* Associate degree, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.

 **What’s needed \- Preferred Qualifications**

* 1\+ years of experience in sales or service in a business\-to\-business environment.
* Experience meeting or exceeding productivity goals, quotas, or sales metrics.
* Experience using CRM tools, Salesforce.com, or a comparable sales platform.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

 **We Offer**

* Inclusive culture with associate\-led Business Resource Groups
* 112 Hours of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays \+ 1 floating holiday)
* Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!

  



*The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, business considerations, geography, and internal equity. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements.*
